items.title: 華為三摺疊新機開售 各版本均已斷貨
items.title_en: Huawei's Triple-Fold New Device Launches, All Versions Sold Out
paras: 華為三摺疊新機Mate XT 2非凡大師周六（12日）10:08開啟全渠道首銷，售價人民幣19,999元起。
各版本售價分別為：16GB+256GB為19,999元，16GB+512GB為21,999元，16GB+1TB為23,999元，16GB+1TB靈盾防窺螢幕為24,999元。
據《財聯社》報導，華為商城顯示，Mate XT 2非凡大師開售即售罄，各個配色及版本均已斷貨。
paras_en: Huawei's triple-fold new device Mate XT 2 “Extraordinary Master” opened its first sale across all channels on Saturday (the 12th) at 10:08, with a starting price of RMB 19,999.
The pricing for each configuration is as follows: 16GB+256GB at RMB 19,999, 16GB+512GB at RMB 21,999, 16GB+1TB at RMB 23,999, and 16GB+1TB with a privacy‑shield screen at RMB 24,999.
According to Caixin, Huawei’s online store shows that the Mate XT 2 Extraordinary Master sold out immediately upon launch, with every color and version already out of stock.

items.title: 若升息美股反有望迎「下一波多頭」行情？Fed升息機率飆至87%
items.title_en: If Rate Hikes Could Spark the Next Bull Market for U.S. Stocks? Fed Hike Odds Jump to 87%
paras: 市場對美國聯準會（Fed）升息的預期快速升溫，壓抑本週美股表現，標普500指數下跌約0.7%，那斯達克綜合指數回落0.5%，道瓊工業指數則下挫1.4%。不過，部分市場人士認為，如果升息能有效穩定債市、遏制通膨，這次升息反而可能成為股市下一階段行情的催化劑。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預期升息機率已從一週前的59%大幅升至週五（11日）的87%。
本週公布的通膨數據顯示，物價漲幅仍高於聯準會2%的目標，加上油價本週再漲9%，通膨壓力短期內似乎仍難以緩解。
此外，美國前一週公布的8月就業報告表現強勁，也進一步增加市場對升息的預期。
不過，即使聯準會最終升息25個基點，市場實際受到的衝擊可能沒有想像中大，原因在於利率本身已經出現明顯上行。
10年期美國公債殖利率已從6月底的4.4%大幅升至接近5%，2年期殖利率也出現幅度相近的升幅。30年期美債殖利率週四（10日）收在5.36%，創下2004年6月以來最高水準。
殖利率快速攀升自然對股市構成壓力。儘管分析師已連續21週上調企業獲利預期，但美股自6月以來整體幾乎原地踏步。
然而，市場至今並未出現災難性崩跌。
美銀全球股票衍生品研究主管Benjamin Bowler指出，市場確實擔心利率變化可能干擾股市，但科技股熱潮形成的動能相當強勁，宏觀經濟風險必須達到相當高的程度，才足以對市場構成威脅。
Bowler並指出，類似情況也曾出現在1990年代末期。當時30年期美債殖利率上升2個百分點，聯準會升息幅度超過1個百分點，但那斯達克指數仍持續上演多頭行情。
他預期，即使股市出現修正，買盤仍可能迅速回流，讓市場重新走強，網路泡沫時期及較近期的市場表現都曾出現類似情況。
在這樣的背景下，若美股再度走低，投資人可能反而將回檔視為進場機會，短期利率稍微走高未必足以改變這項趨勢。
投資公司Madison固定收益主管Mike Sanders認為，關鍵在於升息能否穩定長天期債券殖利率。
Sanders表示，在目前的環境下，升息可能向市場傳遞明確訊號，顯示聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）確實致力於壓制通膨。反過來說，如果華許在此前承諾要讓高通膨「成為過去」後，卻選擇避開升息，可能讓市場認為聯準會只是口頭表態。
這種情況可能損害聯準會的政策公信力，也可能加深市場對未來多年通膨維持高檔的擔憂。
從這個角度來看，一次市場已大致消化、且被認為有必要的升息，對長天期債券與股票反而可能成為相對正面的事件。
畢竟，債券投資人不希望看到高通膨，股市投資人同樣不樂見物價持續上升，尤其當通膨已對消費者信心造成明顯壓力。
這或許也能解釋，為何週五通膨數據略高於市場預期後，標普500指數反而上漲近1%，終結連續4個交易日的跌勢。
市場當時的解讀是，若聯準會因通膨壓力被迫升息，反而有助於維持政策公信力。
從傳統角度來看，股市通常不歡迎升息，因為更高利率可能抑制經濟活動，也會提高債券相較股票的吸引力。
但目前的市場環境呈現出一項矛盾現象：投資人關注的可能不只是利率究竟上升多少，而是政策是否足夠明確、能否帶來穩定性。
本週稍早，隨著市場對升息的預期升溫，美股確實承受壓力；但如果升息已被市場充分反映，同時又被視為控制通膨所需的政策行動，那麼升息本身反而可能降低市場對通膨失控的疑慮。
一旦這項不確定性下降，市場注意力就可能重新回到AI建設熱潮，以及由此帶動的企業獲利成長。
paras_en: The market’s expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike have heated up quickly, weighing on this week’s U.S. equities performance: the S&P 500 fell about 0.7%, the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.4%. However, some market participants believe that if a hike can effectively stabilize the bond market and curb inflation, the move could actually become a catalyst for the next phase of the equity rally.
According to Barron’s, the CME FedWatch tool shows the market’s probability of a rate hike has surged from 59% a week ago to 87% on Friday (the 11th).
Inflation data released this week showed price gains remain above the Fed’s 2% target, and with oil prices up another 9% this week, inflationary pressure appears unlikely to ease in the short term.
In addition, a strong August jobs report released by the United States last week further heightened expectations of a rate hike.
Even if the Fed ultimately raises rates by 25 basis points, the actual market impact may be smaller than imagined because rates have already risen sharply.

The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has jumped from 4.4% at the end of June to near 5%, and the 2‑year yield has risen by a similar margin. The 30‑year yield closed at 5.36% on Thursday (the 10th), the highest level since June 2004.
Rapidly climbing yields naturally put pressure on equities. Although analysts have upgraded corporate earnings forecasts for 21 consecutive weeks, the overall U.S. market has barely moved since June.
Nevertheless, the market has not experienced a catastrophic crash so far.

Benjamin Bowler, head of global equity derivatives research at Bank of America, said the market is indeed worried that rate changes could disrupt equities, but the momentum behind the tech‑stock rally is strong, and macro‑economic risks would have to be quite severe to threaten the market.

Bowler noted a similar situation occurred in the late 1990s. Back then, the 30‑year Treasury yield rose two percentage points and the Fed’s hikes exceeded one percentage point, yet the Nasdaq continued its bull run.
He expects that even if a correction occurs, buying pressure could quickly return, reviving market strength—a pattern seen during the dot‑com bubble and more recent periods.
In this context, if U.S. stocks dip again, investors may actually view the pull‑back as a buying opportunity; a modest rise in short‑term rates may not be enough to alter that trend.
Mike Sanders, head of fixed income at Madison Investment, believes the key is whether the hike can stabilize long‑term bond yields.

Sanders said that in the current environment, a hike could send a clear signal that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is truly committed to taming inflation. Conversely, if Warsh, after pledging to make high inflation “a thing of the past,” avoids a hike, the market might view the Fed as merely paying lip service.
Such a scenario could damage the Fed’s policy credibility and deepen concerns that inflation will stay elevated for years to come.
From that perspective, a rate hike that the market has largely priced in and deems necessary could actually be a relatively positive event for long‑term bonds and equities.
After all, bond investors don’t want high inflation, and equity investors likewise dislike rising prices, especially when inflation is already putting clear pressure on consumer confidence.
That may also explain why, after Friday’s inflation numbers came in slightly above expectations, the S&P 500 rose nearly 1%, ending a four‑day losing streak.
The market’s reading at the time was that if the Fed is forced to hike due to inflation pressure, it could help preserve policy credibility.
Traditionally, equities dislike rate hikes because higher rates can dampen economic activity and make bonds more attractive relative to stocks.
But the current market environment shows a paradox: investors may care less about how much rates rise and more about whether policy is clear enough and can deliver stability.

Earlier this week, as expectations of a hike warmed, U.S. stocks indeed felt pressure; however, if the hike is already fully priced in and seen as a necessary step to control inflation, the hike itself could actually reduce worries about runaway inflation.
Once that uncertainty fades, market focus may shift back to the AI construction boom and the earnings growth it drives.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro系列在中國正式預售 開售數分鐘首批貨源賣光
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Series Begins Pre‑sale in China, First Stock Sells Out Within Minutes
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone 18 Pro系列12日（周六）晚8點正式啟動預售，開售僅數分鐘，蘋果中國官網、淘寶、京東等主流電商平台多個熱門型號首批貨源相繼售罄。
冰川藍色iPhone 18 Pro及 iPhone 18 Pro Max的256GB、512GB、1TB在蘋果官網預計發貨時間均已推遲至9月30日。
據《科創板日報》報導，今天下午，深圳一家蘋果授權店iPhone 18 Pro系列的登記預訂量已有五六十單，預訂無需支付定金，門市採取「到貨後按登記順序通知」 方式發售。
店員說，在顏色偏好方面，登記預訂的消費者中，選擇藍色與酒紅色兩款配色的人數最多。
值得一提的是，首批貨源快速消化，部分急於第一時間入手新機的消費者，開始轉向第三方渠道求購，iPhone 18 Pro 系列的市場成交價格也隨之出現波動。
在得物App上，iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB勃艮第酒紅色成交均價為人民幣（下同）12,799元，大漲1,800元，漲幅16.4%；同為256GB的銀色版本成交均價達到13,999元，漲了3,000元，漲幅27.3%。
iPhone 18 Pro價格上漲幅度相對較小。256GB勃艮第酒紅色和銀色版本成交均價均為10,999元，漲1000元，漲幅10.0%；冰川藍色256GB成交均價為11,499元，漲1,500元，漲幅15.0%。1TB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交均價為16,699元，漲1,200元，漲幅7.7%。
高容量版本的市場價格同樣出現上漲。iPhone 18 Pro Max冰川藍色1TB成交均價為18,299元，漲1,800元，漲幅10.9%；黑色2TB成交均價達到24,700元，漲3,201元，漲幅14.9%。
在得物App首輪預售成交數量中，iPhone 18 Pro Max和iPhone 18 Pro的256GB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交數量最多，是目前成交熱度最高的機型。
手機渠道商家表示，今年首批市場價格是否會持續處於高檔，需要觀察後續供給。
該商家說，從產品變化來看，iPhone 18 Pro系列此次升級更多集中在晶片、通訊、續航散熱、影像等內部能力，外觀整體變化相對有限，消費者對部分升級的直觀感知可能並不強。
與此同時，新機價格上漲也進一步提高渠道商的備貨成本和囤貨風險，部分商家對首批新機的收貨相對謹慎。
該商家提到：「蘋果的產能爬升速度比較快，發售後三到四周供給會明顯增加。剛開始貨少，現貨價格會高一點，隨著貨源陸續進入市場，價格一般會在10月中下旬進入相對穩定階段。」
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched the pre‑sale of the iPhone 18 Pro series at 8 p.m. on Saturday, the 12th. Within minutes the first batches of several popular models on Apple’s China website, Taobao, JD.com and other major e‑commerce platforms sold out.
The Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in 256 GB, 512 GB and 1 TB configurations have had their estimated shipping dates on Apple’s website pushed back to September 30.

According to the Science‑Innovation Board Daily, an Apple‑authorized store in Shenzhen reported this afternoon that it had already received fifty‑to‑sixty registration orders for the iPhone 18 Pro series. No deposit is required for registration, and the store will notify customers in registration order once the devices arrive.
The sales staff said that among the registered customers, the blue and burgundy color options were the most popular.

It is worth noting that the rapid sell‑through of the first stock prompted some eager buyers to turn to third‑party channels, causing market transaction prices for the iPhone 18 Pro series to fluctuate.
On the Dewu app, the average transaction price for the 256 GB iPhone 18 Pro Max in Burgundy rose to ¥12,799, up ¥1,800 or 16.4%. The 256 GB silver version averaged ¥13,999, up ¥3,000 or 27.3%.

The iPhone 18 Pro saw smaller price increases. Both the 256 GB Burgundy and silver versions averaged ¥10,999, up ¥1,000 (10.0%). The 256 GB Glacier‑blue averaged ¥11,499, up ¥1,500 (15.0%). The 1 TB Burgundy version averaged ¥16,699, up ¥1,200 (7.7%).
High‑capacity models also rose in price. The 1 TB Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro Max averaged ¥18,299, up ¥1,800 (10.9%). The 2 TB black version averaged ¥24,700, up ¥3,201 (14.9%).

In the first round of pre‑sale transactions on Dewu, the 256 GB Burgundy versions of both iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro recorded the highest sales volumes, making them the hottest models so far.
Channel merchants said it remains to be seen whether the initial market prices will stay high this year, depending on subsequent supply.

The merchant noted that the iPhone 18 Pro series upgrades focus more on internal capabilities such as the chip, communications, battery life, thermal management and imaging, with relatively limited exterior changes, so consumers may not perceive the upgrades strongly.
At the same time, the price hikes increase merchants’ inventory costs and stocking risks, leading some to be cautious about receiving the first batch of new phones.

The merchant added: “Apple’s production ramp‑up is relatively fast; supply will increase noticeably three to four weeks after launch. Early on, limited stock drives higher spot prices, but as inventory flows into the market, prices should stabilize around mid‑to‑late October.”

items.title: 南韓半導體出口首破400兆韓元！AI需求推升三星、SK海力士業績
items.title_en: South Korea's Semiconductor Exports Break 400 Trillion Won for the First Time, AI Demand Boosts Samsung and SK Hynix Earnings
paras: 南韓半導體出口今年以來首度突破400兆韓元大關，人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）等產品需求，三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 業績同步走強，半導體在南韓出口結構中的占比也進一步攀升。
南韓關稅廳週五（11日）公布數據顯示，9月前10天南韓半導體出口額達164.8億美元，年增270.1%，創歷年同期新高。
同期間，南韓整體出口額為349.7億美元，半導體占比達47.1%，較去年同期大增23.9個百分點。
今年以來截至9月前10天，南韓半導體累計出口額已達2976.8億美元，折合約400.5兆韓元，首度突破400兆韓元。
南韓半導體出口規模也已遠超過過去年度紀錄。2025年全年出口額為1734億美元，2024年則為1419億美元；今年9月初，2025年的年度紀錄便已遭大幅超越。
若目前出口成長趨勢延續，南韓半導體出口有望連續第3年創下年度新高。

半導體成南韓突破1兆美元出口關鍵

半導體產業景氣升溫，也推動南韓朝年度出口額突破1兆美元的目標邁進。
南韓關稅廳數據顯示，截至9月10日，南韓今年累計出口額已達7285.6億美元，超越2025年全年7093億美元的出口規模。
目前全球僅美國、中國與德國曾實現年度出口額突破1兆美元，南韓若要成為第4個達成這項規模的國家，半導體出口能否維持強勁成長，將成為重要因素。
隨著全球AI基礎建設投資預計在下半年持續成長，半導體需求能否延續目前的強勢表現，也將直接影響南韓全年出口表現。

三星、SK海力士受惠AI記憶體需求

三星電子與SK海力士是此次南韓半導體出口成長的主要支柱，兩家公司均受惠於AI應用帶動的HBM需求，以及記憶體晶片價格上漲。
三星電子半導體事業第1季營收達81.7兆韓元，營業利益為53.7兆韓元；第2季營收進一步升至127.5兆韓元，營業利益達89.2兆韓元。
累計上半年，三星電子半導體事業營收達209.2兆韓元，營業利益為142.9兆韓元。
SK海力士第1季營收為52.5763兆韓元，營業利益37.6103兆韓元；第2季營收增至79.3187兆韓元，營業利益達60.5426兆韓元。
上半年SK海力士累計營收為131.895兆韓元，營業利益98.1529兆韓元，營業利益率達76.3%。
KB證券表示，隨著記憶體晶片價格上漲及HBM供應增加，三星電子已進入業績快速成長階段。
KB證券研究主管Kim Dong-won指出，在現行3年股東回報計畫下，三星電子預計第3季進行30兆韓元現金股利，年內也可能透過股票買回及註銷、現金股利等方式進一步提高股東回報，目前剩餘可用資金約80兆韓元。
他表示，三星電子即將公布的新一輪3年股東回報政策，可能進一步提高股利比例，使股東回報率超過目前自由現金流50%的水準。

半導體熱潮延燒　韓股資金聚焦龍頭

三星電子與SK海力士業績強勁，也帶動南韓投資人對半導體股的關注。
金融數據業者FnGuide統計，9月1日至7日，三星電子以1672次搜尋次數成為南韓投資人搜尋最多的股票，SK海力士則以1342次排名第2。排名第3的現代汽車搜尋次數為679次，與兩大半導體企業存在明顯差距。
半導體市場的樂觀情緒也延伸至海外市場。美國投行Piper Sandler給予AMD「增持」評級，並將目標價設定為600美元。
此外，南韓生技醫藥產業也受到市場關注。KOSDAQ市值最大的企業Alteogen與瑞士製藥商諾華簽署獨家授權協議，將ALT-B4平台授權予諾華使用。
新韓證券分析師Um Min-yong表示，這是諾華首次將基因療法轉換為皮下注射劑型的相關合作，技術授權規模也超出市場預期，業務範圍進一步從腫瘤藥物拓展至新的治療模式。隨後，他將Alteogen目標價上調至54萬韓元。
整體而言，AI需求正成為推動南韓出口成長的重要力量。隨著HBM等高附加價值半導體產品需求增加，半導體占南韓出口的比重持續攀升，其對南韓經濟與資本市場的影響也進一步擴大。
paras_en: South Korea's semiconductor exports have surpassed the 400‑trillion‑won mark for the first time this year, as AI infrastructure demand continues to drive demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other products, lifting the performance of Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS); the share of semiconductors in South Korea's export basket also rose further.

Data released by South Korea's customs office on Friday (the 11th) showed that in the first ten days of September, South Korean semiconductor exports amounted to $16.48 billion, up 270.1% year‑on‑year, a record high for the same period in history.
During the same period, total South Korean exports were $34.97 billion, with semiconductors accounting for 47.1% of the total – an increase of 23.9 percentage points from a year earlier.

Since the start of the year up to the first ten days of September, cumulative South Korean semiconductor exports have reached $297.68 billion, roughly 400.5 trillion won, breaking the 400‑trillion‑won barrier for the first time.

The scale of South Korean semiconductor exports now far exceeds past annual records. The full‑year export figure for 2025 was $173.4 billion, and for 2024 it was $141.9 billion; by early September this year the 2025 record had already been vastly surpassed.
If the current export growth trend continues, South Korean semiconductor exports are likely to set a new annual high for the third consecutive year.
Semiconductors are the key to South Korea breaking the $1 trillion export milestone, as the industry’s up‑turn also pushes the country toward its goal of exceeding $1 trillion in annual exports.
Customs data show that as of September 10, South Korea’s cumulative exports for the year have reached $728.56 billion, overtaking the full‑year export volume of 2025, which was $709.3 billion.

To date only the United States, China and Germany have achieved annual export totals above $1 trillion; if South Korea becomes the fourth country to do so, the ability of semiconductor exports to maintain strong growth will be a decisive factor.

With global AI infrastructure investment expected to keep rising in the second half of the year, whether semiconductor demand can sustain its current momentum will directly affect South Korea’s overall export performance.
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the main pillars behind the recent surge in South Korean semiconductor exports, both benefiting from AI‑driven HBM demand and higher memory‑chip prices.

Samsung’s semiconductor division posted first‑quarter revenue of 81.7 trillion won and operating profit of 53.7 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue rose further to 127.5 trillion won with operating profit of 89.2 trillion won.
For the first half of the year, Samsung’s semiconductor business generated revenue of 209.2 trillion won and operating profit of 142.9 trillion won.

SK Hynix reported first‑quarter revenue of 52.5763 trillion won and operating profit of 37.6103 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue increased to 79.3187 trillion won with operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won.
For the first half, SK Hynix’s cumulative revenue was 131.895 trillion won, operating profit 98.1529 trillion won, yielding an operating margin of 76.3%.
KB Securities said that with memory‑chip prices rising and HBM supply expanding, Samsung has entered a phase of rapid earnings growth.

KB Securities research head Kim Dong‑won noted that under the current three‑year shareholder‑return plan, Samsung plans a 30‑trillion‑won cash dividend in Q3 and may further boost shareholder returns later this year through share buybacks, cancellations and additional cash dividends, with roughly 80 trillion won of usable funds remaining.
He added that Samsung’s upcoming new three‑year shareholder‑return policy could raise the dividend payout ratio, pushing the shareholder‑return rate above the current free‑cash‑flow level of 50%.
The semiconductor boom is spilling over to the equity market, with strong results from Samsung and SK Hynix drawing South Korean investors’ attention to semiconductor stocks.

FnGuide data show that from September 1‑7, Samsung was searched 1,672 times, the most‑searched stock among South Korean investors, while SK Hynix ranked second with 1,342 searches; the third‑most‑searched stock, Hyundai Motor, recorded 679 searches, a clear gap from the two semiconductor giants.
Optimism in the semiconductor market is also extending overseas. U.S. investment bank Piper Sandler upgraded AMD to an “overweight” rating and set a target price of $600.

In addition, South Korea’s biotech sector is attracting interest. Alteogen, the largest KOSDAQ‑listed company by market cap, signed an exclusive licensing agreement with Swiss pharma giant Novartis to grant Novartis use of its ALT‑B4 platform.

Um Min‑yong, an analyst at Shinhan Securities, said this is Novartis’s first collaboration to convert a gene‑therapy product into a subcutaneous injection, with the licensing scope exceeding market expectations and expanding the business from oncology drugs to new therapeutic modalities; he subsequently raised Alteogen’s target price to 540,000 won.

Overall, AI demand is becoming a major driver of South Korea’s export growth. As demand for high‑value‑added semiconductor products such as HBM rises, the share of semiconductors in South Korean exports continues to climb, amplifying its impact on the country’s economy and capital markets.

items.title: 中國邁向「工業5.0」！大摩： 未來10年或迎來12兆美元實體投資超級週期
items.title_en: China Moves Toward “Industry 5.0”! Morgan Stanley: A $12 trillion Physical‑Investment Super‑Cycle Could Unfold Over the Next Decade
paras: 摩根士丹利最新研報指出，中國工業正進入新的發展階段，產業競爭優勢將逐步從過去的低成本與製造規模，轉向生態系統整合及創新能力。大摩認為，這項轉型可能重塑中國工業超級週期、製造業利潤分配，以及中國在全球製造價值鏈中的角色。
大摩指出，市場過去談論中國製造業時，往往聚焦於產能過剩、低價競爭、利潤率承壓，以及「中國+1」（China+1）帶動的供應鏈外移。但更值得關注的是，中國製造業下一階段將如何演變。
報告將中國的轉型形容為從「世界工廠」走向「全球工業作業系統」，亦即把製造規模、自動化、人工智慧（AI）、完整供應鏈及全球部署能力進一步整合。
在工業4.0已推進數位化與互聯互通後，中國工業可能進一步進入「工業5.0」階段。

工業5.0三大支柱：智慧、韌性與領導力

大摩表示，中國已具備進入工業5.0的強大基礎，目前約占全球製造業增加值28%，涵蓋聯合國定義的666個製造業子類別，且在全球逾半數出口產品中排名第一。
此外，中國已有超過3萬座智慧工廠及1億個聯網工業設備，構成下一階段發展所需的實體與數據基礎。
大摩認為，下一階段的關鍵，在於中國能否讓既有工業體系進一步具備適應性、自主性，並深度融入全球產業體系。
報告將工業5.0的發展方向歸納為三大支柱，並預期出現5項重要突破。
首先是工業智慧，包括AI原生、自適應工廠，以及具身AI（Embodied AI），讓原本依賴體力勞動的工作逐步轉化為能透過軟體升級的資本。
其次是產業韌性，包括建立自主可控且能持續演進的工業技術堆疊，以及從單純出口產品進一步轉向輸出完整工業生態系統。
第三則是技術領導力，中國可能在部分具戰略意義的領域取得技術主導地位，尤其是那些能同時提升大量下游產業效率的上游基礎層。

2026至2035年新增工業資本支出估達80兆元

大摩指出，工業5.0並非單純的技術升級，而是需要對生產體系進行大規模重建，因此將形成一輪實體投資超級週期。
大摩估計，2026年至2035年，中國工業將帶來約12兆美元、相當於80兆元人民幣的新增工業資本支出；同期工業資本支出累計總額則約達50兆美元。
投資將主要流向AI、電力與數位基礎建設，以及工廠自動化、機器人、感測器、控制系統與軟體等領域，同時涵蓋半導體、先進材料、能源、交通運輸及其他尖端產業的策略性產能。
不過，大摩預期短期投資增速仍相對溫和。2025年至2027年，在「反內卷」行動持續下，工業投資增速估計約為4%至5%；2028年至2035年則可能加速，複合年增率（CAGR）升至6%至7%。

生產率與利潤率改善 製造業全球占比有望升至30%

大摩認為，工業5.0帶來的回報可能呈現類似J曲線的發展模式，主要體現在工業利潤率、潛在GDP及全球製造業占比3方面。
首先，隨著產業價值逐步由傳統製造環節轉向軟體、設備、材料、服務及平台，工業利潤率預期可由約5%提升至8%。
其次，中國潛在GDP水準預估將提高約3.5%，而生產率提升帶來的效益，預計在2020年代後期開始更加明顯。
第三，中國占全球製造業增加值的比重，預估將由目前約28%進一步提高至30%。

「中國製造」轉向「中國創造並製造」

面對「中國+1」及製造業回流等趨勢，大摩認為，短期內要完整複製中國的上游產業生態系統仍相當困難。
因此，下一階段全球製造業分工可能更多呈現「Made by China」的模式，也就是中國不僅出口最終產品，也向海外製造體系提供零組件、機械設備、生產系統、技術及服務網路，並將相關標準進一步嵌入全球工業生態系統。
在此過程中，全球製造體系仍將朝更加多極化的方向發展。

政策、技術與地緣政治 將決定工業5.0發展速度

大摩指出，中國邁向工業5.0的路徑並不會呈現線性發展，政策、技術與地緣政治將是三項主要影響因素。
若中國對居民需求的政策支持力度提高、工業AI取得更快突破，且海外市場准入維持穩定，都可能加快相關技術商業化、提高生產率並推動產業部署。
反之，若財政過早收緊，加上投資過度集中於供給端，可能導致「智慧化產能過剩」、通縮以及投資報酬率偏低。
此外，技術瓶頸、對外投資限制持續時間過長，以及貿易摩擦，也可能延後相關技術導入與中國企業的海外擴張。

工業5.0帶來結構性投資機會

在股市方面，大摩認為，工業5.0可能帶來一輪效率與股東權益報酬率（ROE）週期，受惠產業主要可分為5大類。
一是工業智慧賦能者，包括軟體、自動化、控制系統、感測器及機器人。
二是自主可控的關鍵瓶頸環節，例如晶圓廠設備（WFE）、電子設計自動化（EDA）、電腦數值控制（CNC）工具機、計量設備及先進材料。
三是尖端平台，包括人形機器人、自動駕駛系統、電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）及航空太空。
四是生態系統出口商，例如新能源車—電池—充電、光伏—儲能—電網，以及智慧工廠。
五是全球領導者，包括汽車、電子、半導體及機械產業。
大摩表示，目前市場已反映的因素主要包括短期資本支出擴張及中國國產化題材；相較之下，中國長期轉型潛力、生產率提升帶動的ROE復甦、利潤向上游軟體與設備環節轉移，以及全球潛在市場總規模（TAM）所帶來的空間，可能尚未被市場充分計入。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley’s latest research notes that China’s industry is entering a new development stage, with competitive advantages shifting from low‑cost, large‑scale manufacturing to ecosystem integration and innovation capability. The firm believes this transformation could reshape China’s industrial super‑cycle, manufacturing profit distribution, and its role in the global manufacturing value chain.

Morgan Stanley points out that past discussions of China’s manufacturing sector have often focused on overcapacity, low‑price competition, pressure on profit margins, and the “China + 1” supply‑chain relocation trend. A more important issue is how China’s manufacturing will evolve in its next phase.

The report describes China’s transformation as moving from a “world factory” to a “global industrial operating system,” further integrating manufacturing scale, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), full‑stack supply chains and worldwide deployment capabilities.
After Industry 4.0 has driven digitisation and interconnectivity, China’s industry may advance into an “Industry 5.0” stage.

Industry 5.0’s three pillars are intelligence, resilience and leadership. Morgan Stanley says China already has a strong foundation for entering Industry 5.0, accounting for roughly 28 % of global manufacturing value‑added across the United Nations‑defined 666 manufacturing sub‑categories and ranking first in more than half of worldwide export products.
In addition, China now has over 30,000 smart factories and 100 million networked industrial devices, forming the physical and data base needed for the next development phase.
Morgan Stanley believes the key to the next stage is whether China can make its existing industrial system more adaptable, autonomous and deeply integrated into the global industrial ecosystem.
The report summarises Industry 5.0’s development direction into three pillars and anticipates five major breakthroughs.
The first pillar is industrial intelligence, including AI‑native, self‑adapting factories and embodied AI, turning labour‑intensive work into capital that can be upgraded through software.

The second pillar is industrial resilience, involving the creation of an autonomous, continuously evolving technology stack and a shift from merely exporting products to exporting complete industrial ecosystems.
The third pillar is technological leadership, where China could achieve dominance in strategically important upstream areas that boost efficiency across many downstream industries.
Industry 5.0 is not just a technology upgrade but requires massive rebuilding of production systems, which will generate a new super‑cycle of physical investment, Morgan Stanley estimates.

Morgan Stanley projects that from 2026 to 2035 China’s industry will generate about $12 trillion (≈80 trillion RMB) of new industrial capital expenditure, with cumulative industrial capex reaching roughly $50 trillion over the same period.

Investment will flow mainly into AI, power and digital infrastructure, as well as factory automation, robotics, sensors, control systems and software, while also covering strategic capacity in semiconductors, advanced materials, energy, transportation and other high‑tech sectors.

However, Morgan Stanley expects short‑term investment growth to remain moderate. From 2025‑2027, amid continued “anti‑overwork” policies, industrial investment is forecast to grow about 4‑5 % annually; from 2028‑2035 the compound annual growth rate could accelerate to 6‑7 %.
The returns from Industry 5.0 may follow a J‑curve pattern, reflected in industrial profit margins, potential GDP and the global share of manufacturing value‑added, Morgan Stanley says.
First, as industrial value shifts from traditional manufacturing to software, equipment, materials, services and platforms, industrial profit margins are expected to rise from roughly 5 % to 8 %.
Second, China’s potential GDP is projected to increase by about 3.5 %, with productivity gains becoming more evident in the late 2020s.
Third, China’s share of global manufacturing value‑added is expected to climb from the current ~28 % to about 30 %.

“Made in China” will evolve into “Made and Created by China.” Facing “China + 1” and reshoring trends, Morgan Stanley believes fully replicating China’s upstream ecosystem abroad will remain difficult in the short term.

Thus, the next phase of global manufacturing division may feature a “Made by China” model, where China not only exports finished goods but also supplies components, machinery, production systems, technology and service networks to overseas factories, embedding related standards into the global industrial ecosystem.
In this process, the worldwide manufacturing system will continue moving toward greater multipolarity.
Policy, technology and geopolitics will determine the speed of Industry 5.0 development, Morgan Stanley notes, and the path will not be linear.

If China strengthens policy support for domestic demand, accelerates breakthroughs in industrial AI, and maintains stable overseas market access, commercialization of related technologies could speed up, boosting productivity and industry deployment.
Conversely, premature fiscal tightening and overly supply‑side‑focused investment could lead to “smart capacity overhang,” deflation and low investment returns.
Moreover, prolonged technical bottlenecks, restrictions on outbound investment and trade frictions could delay technology adoption and Chinese firms’ overseas expansion.

Industry 5.0 creates structural investment opportunities. In equities, Morgan Stanley sees a cycle of efficiency and higher return on equity (ROE), with beneficiary industries grouped into five categories.
The first category comprises industrial‑intelligence enablers such as software, automation, control systems, sensors and robotics.

The second includes autonomous, controllable key bottleneck segments like wafer‑fab equipment (WFE), electronic design automation (EDA), computer‑numerical‑control (CNC) tools, metrology equipment and advanced materials.
The third covers cutting‑edge platforms, including humanoid robots, autonomous driving systems, electric vertical‑take‑off‑and‑landing aircraft (eVTOL) and aerospace.
The fourth consists of ecosystem exporters, for example new‑energy‑vehicle battery‑charging networks, photovoltaic‑storage‑grid solutions, and smart factories.
The fifth comprises global leaders in automotive, electronics, semiconductor and machinery sectors.

Morgan Stanley says the market has already priced in short‑term capex expansion and China‑localisation themes; by contrast, the long‑term transformation potential, productivity‑driven ROE recovery, profit shift toward upstream software and equipment, and the size of the global total addressable market may still be under‑appreciated.

items.title: 蘋果CEO特努斯談iPhone Duo：「軟硬體一體」才是摺疊螢幕核心
items.title_en: Apple CEO Ternus on iPhone Duo: "Hardware‑Software Integration" Is the Core of Foldable Screens
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊 iPhone 正式亮相後，執行長特納斯（John Ternus）與行銷資深副總裁Greg Joswiak接受媒體聯訪，談及這款新品的研發理念、設計方向、定價策略，以及蘋果如何在產品開發過程中維持機密。
根據《Tom's Guide》報導，特納斯表示，蘋果始終將產品品質、耐用度與設計標準視為推出新品的重要門檻，只有整體產品構想符合公司既定要求，才會正式推向市場。
他指出，iPhone Duo 專案讓團隊有機會從零開始探索新的產品形式，重新思考硬體、軟體及整體產品形態，並藉由軟硬體整合打造最終產品。
Joswiak表示，蘋果曾研究市場上現有的摺疊手機，認為部分產品在設計上存在較強的「拼接感」，因此團隊希望透過不同的螢幕比例與軟體體驗，讓 iPhone Duo 建立自身特色。
iPhone Duo 採用 1:1.4 的螢幕比例，同時重新設計軟體使用體驗，以配合摺疊形態。
針對摺疊螢幕常見的手感問題，蘋果在內螢幕表層採用聚合物材質，並自行開發奈米紋理表面工藝，改善螢幕表面的平整度與觸控手感，同時提升耐用性。
特納斯指出，部分市售摺疊裝置的螢幕存在觸感偏向塑膠、表面褶皺起伏等問題，而蘋果開發的奈米紋理工藝，就是希望針對這些問題進行改善。
摺疊 iPhone 的相關消息早已在產品正式發表前曝光，部分產品規格也提前流出。對此，兩名蘋果高層也談到 iPhone Duo 在研發期間採取的保密措施。
特納斯與Joswiak表示，為保護核心技術，iPhone Duo 專案使用與產品無直接關聯的內部代號，並強化整個開發流程的保密管理。
雖然螢幕比例等資訊提前曝光，但可摺疊奈米紋理顯示螢幕這項核心技術細節，仍成功維持到產品正式發表，成為此次研發保密工作的成果之一。
iPhone Duo 起跳價為1999美元，明顯高於一般智慧手機。對於產品定價，特納斯坦言價格確實較高，但蘋果團隊認為，其整體產品體驗具備相應價值。
Joswiak則解釋，iPhone Duo 的命名本身就反映產品定位，意在代表這款裝置整合兩類裝置的使用能力。
另一方面，剛接任蘋果執行長約一週的特納斯也談到履新後的感受。他表示，能夠接下蘋果發展的接力棒是一項莫大榮幸，自己半生職涯都在蘋果度過，對公司及研發團隊抱有深厚感情，也期待帶領團隊持續推動產品創新。
工程師出身的特納斯在產品溝通上的表現，也被形容較前任管理者更為外放。他回憶，在看到 iPhone Duo 的螢幕原型機時，就確認這是團隊希望打造的產品方向。
paras_en: After the official unveiling of Apple’s (AAPL-US) first foldable iPhone, CEO John Ternus and senior vice president of marketing Greg Joswiak fielded joint media questions, discussing the product’s development philosophy, design direction, pricing strategy, and how Apple maintains secrecy throughout the development process.

According to Tom’s Guide, Ternus said Apple always treats product quality, durability and design standards as critical thresholds for launching new items; only when the overall concept meets the company’s established criteria does it move to market.

He noted that the iPhone Duo project gave the team a chance to start from scratch and explore a new product form, re‑thinking hardware, software and the overall product shape, and to create the final device through tight hardware‑software integration.

Joswiak said Apple studied existing foldable phones on the market and found many of them suffered from a pronounced “joint” feel in their design, so the team aimed to give the iPhone Duo its own identity by using different screen ratios and software experiences.
The iPhone Duo uses a 1:1.4 screen ratio and features a redesigned software experience to suit its folding form factor.

To address common tactile issues with foldable displays, Apple applied a polymer coating to the inner screen surface and developed its own nano‑texture surface process, improving flatness, touch feel and durability.
Ternus pointed out that some commercial foldable devices have screens that feel plasticky and show surface creases, and Apple’s nano‑texture process was created specifically to remedy those problems.

News about the foldable iPhone had leaked before the official launch, with some specifications surfacing early; the two Apple executives also discussed the confidentiality measures taken during iPhone Duo’s development.

Ternus and Joswiak said that, to protect core technology, the iPhone Duo project used an internal code name unrelated to the product and tightened secrecy controls throughout the development workflow.

Although details such as the screen ratio were leaked early, the core technology of a foldable nano‑texture display remained concealed until the official announcement, marking a success of the secrecy effort.
The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, clearly higher than typical smartphones. On pricing, Ternus admitted the cost is indeed steep, but the Apple team believes the overall experience justifies the price.
Joswiak explained that the name iPhone Duo itself reflects the product’s positioning, intended to signify the device’s ability to combine the functions of two device categories.

Meanwhile, Ternus, who took over as Apple’s CEO about a week ago, spoke about his feelings after assuming the role, saying it is a great honor to inherit Apple’s development baton, that he has spent half his career at Apple, feels deep affection for the company and its R&D teams, and looks forward to leading continued product innovation.

Ternus, an engineer by training, is described as more outgoing in product communication than his predecessor; he recalled that when he saw the iPhone Duo screen prototype, he immediately confirmed it was the direction the team wanted to pursue.

items.title: OpenAI開放Agents API！Codex代理框架全面向開發者開放
paras: OpenAI正將支撐旗下程式設計代理Codex的底層技術進一步對外開放，將過去累積於內部產品與企業服務的人工智慧（AI）代理開發經驗，轉化為開發者可直接使用的API。
OpenAI近日宣布，Agents API正式進入公開測試階段，現在所有開發者均可使用。過去這套代理框架及相關基礎設施主要應用於Codex與企業版ChatGPT，如今則以API形式開放，開發者不需額外支付訂閱費，只須按照實際使用的token及工具呼叫量付費。
隨著Codex及ChatGPT for Work過去一年觸及全球數百萬名使用者，OpenAI在實際應用中發現，讓AI代理長時間執行複雜任務，單靠模型本身並不足夠。
代理還需要能夠管理上下文、使用工具、協調其他代理，以及在能讀寫檔案、執行程式碼並保存中間結果的環境中持續運作。
早期客戶的使用結果也顯示，這套架構已帶來一定效益。SafetyKit將案件審核流程移轉至Agents API後，單一案件的處理成本降低60%；Hypha透過將代理執行框架與沙箱環境分離，使代理回應失敗率降低86%；科技公司Cirridae的評估分數則由0.71提升至0.85，同時延遲降低4倍。

單次API呼叫即可建立長時間運作代理

Agents API的主要目的，是降低企業及開發者打造長時間運作AI代理所需的工程成本。
過去每當新的AI模型推出，開發者往往需要重新調整甚至重建自己的代理執行框架，才能使用模型新增的能力。
OpenAI希望透過版本化的Agents API，讓模型更新能直接對應相應的能力，而不必由開發者自行重新打造底層架構。
根據OpenAI的設計，開發者只要在API呼叫中指定任務、模型、工具及執行環境，即可建立可用於生產環境的代理，無須自行處理上下文管理及子代理協調等底層工作。
Agents API目前具備3項主要能力。
首先是自動壓縮上下文。當對話內容接近模型上下文容量上限時，系統會自動壓縮較早期的資訊，使代理能夠持續執行數小時甚至數天。
其次是工具搜尋與平行呼叫。系統可依照任務需求載入相關工具定義，降低token使用量，同時允許多項工具呼叫平行執行。
第三則是多代理協作。主要代理可以將複雜工作拆解後交給多個子代理平行處理，每個子代理各自維持上下文，再由主要代理整合最終結果。
物流科技公司Nash表示，目前透過Agents API部署數千個長時間運作的AI代理，用於管理全球數億次配送任務，單次代理執行時間可持續數小時甚至數天。

自託管沙箱與多家雲端業者提供部署選項

除了代理框架本身，Agents API也提供不同的執行環境選擇。
OpenAI提供自託管沙箱，並與Codex及ChatGPT採用相同的沙箱基礎設施，讓代理能夠快速啟動並進行彈性擴展。
此外，OpenAI已與Blaxel、Cloudflare、Daytona、DigitalOcean、E2B、Modal、甲骨文（Oracle）、Runloop及Vercel等合作夥伴進行一級整合，提供不同的部署選項，包括私有雲、特定儲存需求，以及不同CPU、GPU與記憶體配置。
OpenAI表示，這種架構可涵蓋從新創團隊快速驗證產品，到企業級正式部署等不同需求。
建築及居家服務AI平台Long Lake表示，透過Agents API，團隊目前可在數小時內將AI代理部署至不同產業，過去則可能需要數天。

開源Codex執行框架　模型升級可直接受惠

Agents API是建立在開源Codex執行框架之上，開發者可以透過公開程式碼庫了解模型呼叫、工具協調及上下文管理等核心運作方式。
OpenAI則負責持續維護及更新這套框架。換言之，當新模型推出時，開發者可直接取得更新後的能力，而不必自行重新設計整套代理架構。
OpenAI指出，Agents API目前仍處於公開測試階段，後續將根據開發者回饋持續調整，並朝正式發布推進。
在工具支援方面，Agents API支援MCP協定、自訂函式及網頁搜尋等內建工具。定價方面，API本身不另收訂閱費，開發者則依實際token消耗及工具使用量支付費用。

items.title: 習近平抵達印度出席金磚峰會！睽違7年訪印、與莫迪3年內第3度會面
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in India for BRICS Summit! First Visit in Seven Years and Third Meeting with Modi in Three Years
paras: 中國國家主席習近平週六（12日）抵達印度新德里，出席金磚國家（BRICS）領導人峰會，並與印度總理莫迪（Narendra Modi）舉行會談。
根據《路透》報導，此次訪問是習近平7年來首次訪問印度，適逢這兩個亞洲鄰國正謹慎重建雙邊關係。
兩國關係在2020年喜馬拉雅山爭議邊境發生軍事衝突後嚴重受損，當時共有20名印度士兵及4名中國士兵死亡。
印度電視頻道畫面顯示，習近平下機後獲紅毯迎接，現場並有印度女性表演傳統舞蹈。
中國外交部發言人週五（11日）表示，習近平與莫迪預定於週六晚間舉行會談，這將是兩國領導人在3年內第3次會面。
該發言人表示，中國「願意」與印度合作，從戰略及長期角度看待雙邊關係，妥善處理分歧，並成為「好鄰居、好朋友，以及相互支持的夥伴」。
金磚國家成員包括巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國、南非、埃及、衣索比亞、印尼、伊朗及阿拉伯聯合大公國。
此次峰會是在地緣政治緊張局勢升高的背景下舉行，美以對伊朗的戰爭、俄烏戰爭，以及這些衝突對全球能源、貿易與運輸造成的干擾，均加劇了當前的地緣政治緊張情勢。
paras_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi on Saturday (the 12th) to attend the BRICS leaders’ summit and hold talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
According to Reuters, this is Xi’s first visit to India in seven years, coming as the two Asian neighbours cautiously work to rebuild bilateral ties.
Relations were severely damaged after a 2020 military clash on the Himalayan border, which left 20 Indian soldiers and four Chinese soldiers dead.
Indian TV footage showed Xi being greeted on the red carpet after disembarking, with Indian women performing a traditional dance at the venue.
China’s foreign ministry spokesperson said on Friday (the 11th) that Xi and Modi were scheduled to meet on Saturday evening, marking the third meeting between the two leaders in three years.

The spokesperson said China is “willing” to cooperate with India, viewing the bilateral relationship from a strategic and long‑term perspective, handling differences properly and becoming a “good neighbor, good friend, and mutually supportive partner.”
BRICS members include Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates.

The summit is held against a backdrop of heightened geopolitical tension, with the US‑Israel war on Iran, the Russia‑Ukraine war, and the resulting disruptions to global energy, trade and transport further intensifying the current geopolitical strain.

items.title: 南韓半導體出口首破400兆韓元！AI需求推升三星、SK海力士業績
items.title_en: South Korea's Semiconductor Exports Break 400 Trillion Won for the First Time, AI Demand Boosts Samsung and SK Hynix Earnings
paras: 南韓半導體出口今年以來首度突破400兆韓元大關，人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）等產品需求，三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 業績同步走強，半導體在南韓出口結構中的占比也進一步攀升。
南韓關稅廳週五（11日）公布數據顯示，9月前10天南韓半導體出口額達164.8億美元，年增270.1%，創歷年同期新高。
同期間，南韓整體出口額為349.7億美元，半導體占比達47.1%，較去年同期大增23.9個百分點。
今年以來截至9月前10天，南韓半導體累計出口額已達2976.8億美元，折合約400.5兆韓元，首度突破400兆韓元。
南韓半導體出口規模也已遠超過過去年度紀錄。2025年全年出口額為1734億美元，2024年則為1419億美元；今年9月初，2025年的年度紀錄便已遭大幅超越。
若目前出口成長趨勢延續，南韓半導體出口有望連續第3年創下年度新高。

半導體成南韓突破1兆美元出口關鍵

半導體產業景氣升溫，也推動南韓朝年度出口額突破1兆美元的目標邁進。
南韓關稅廳數據顯示，截至9月10日，南韓今年累計出口額已達7285.6億美元，超越2025年全年7093億美元的出口規模。
目前全球僅美國、中國與德國曾實現年度出口額突破1兆美元，南韓若要成為第4個達成這項規模的國家，半導體出口能否維持強勁成長，將成為重要因素。
隨著全球AI基礎建設投資預計在下半年持續成長，半導體需求能否延續目前的強勢表現，也將直接影響南韓全年出口表現。

三星、SK海力士受惠AI記憶體需求

三星電子與SK海力士是此次南韓半導體出口成長的主要支柱，兩家公司均受惠於AI應用帶動的HBM需求，以及記憶體晶片價格上漲。
三星電子半導體事業第1季營收達81.7兆韓元，營業利益為53.7兆韓元；第2季營收進一步升至127.5兆韓元，營業利益達89.2兆韓元。
累計上半年，三星電子半導體事業營收達209.2兆韓元，營業利益為142.9兆韓元。
SK海力士第1季營收為52.5763兆韓元，營業利益37.6103兆韓元；第2季營收增至79.3187兆韓元，營業利益達60.5426兆韓元。
上半年SK海力士累計營收為131.895兆韓元，營業利益98.1529兆韓元，營業利益率達76.3%。
KB證券表示，隨著記憶體晶片價格上漲及HBM供應增加，三星電子已進入業績快速成長階段。
KB證券研究主管Kim Dong-won指出，在現行3年股東回報計畫下，三星電子預計第3季進行30兆韓元現金股利，年內也可能透過股票買回及註銷、現金股利等方式進一步提高股東回報，目前剩餘可用資金約80兆韓元。
他表示，三星電子即將公布的新一輪3年股東回報政策，可能進一步提高股利比例，使股東回報率超過目前自由現金流50%的水準。

半導體熱潮延燒　韓股資金聚焦龍頭

三星電子與SK海力士業績強勁，也帶動南韓投資人對半導體股的關注。
金融數據業者FnGuide統計，9月1日至7日，三星電子以1672次搜尋次數成為南韓投資人搜尋最多的股票，SK海力士則以1342次排名第2。排名第3的現代汽車搜尋次數為679次，與兩大半導體企業存在明顯差距。
半導體市場的樂觀情緒也延伸至海外市場。美國投行Piper Sandler給予AMD「增持」評級，並將目標價設定為600美元。
此外，南韓生技醫藥產業也受到市場關注。KOSDAQ市值最大的企業Alteogen與瑞士製藥商諾華簽署獨家授權協議，將ALT-B4平台授權予諾華使用。
新韓證券分析師Um Min-yong表示，這是諾華首次將基因療法轉換為皮下注射劑型的相關合作，技術授權規模也超出市場預期，業務範圍進一步從腫瘤藥物拓展至新的治療模式。隨後，他將Alteogen目標價上調至54萬韓元。
整體而言，AI需求正成為推動南韓出口成長的重要力量。隨著HBM等高附加價值半導體產品需求增加，半導體占南韓出口的比重持續攀升，其對南韓經濟與資本市場的影響也進一步擴大。
paras_en: South Korea's semiconductor exports have surpassed the 400‑trillion‑won mark for the first time this year, as AI infrastructure demand continues to drive demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other products, lifting the performance of Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS); the share of semiconductors in South Korea's export basket also rose further.

Data released by South Korea's customs office on Friday (the 11th) showed that in the first ten days of September, South Korean semiconductor exports amounted to $16.48 billion, up 270.1% year‑on‑year, a record high for the same period in history.
During the same period, total South Korean exports were $34.97 billion, with semiconductors accounting for 47.1% of the total – an increase of 23.9 percentage points from a year earlier.

Since the start of the year up to the first ten days of September, cumulative South Korean semiconductor exports have reached $297.68 billion, roughly 400.5 trillion won, breaking the 400‑trillion‑won barrier for the first time.

The scale of South Korean semiconductor exports now far exceeds past annual records. The full‑year export figure for 2025 was $173.4 billion, and for 2024 it was $141.9 billion; by early September this year the 2025 record had already been vastly surpassed.
If the current export growth trend continues, South Korean semiconductor exports are likely to set a new annual high for the third consecutive year.
Semiconductors are the key to South Korea breaking the $1 trillion export milestone, as the industry’s up‑turn also pushes the country toward its goal of exceeding $1 trillion in annual exports.
Customs data show that as of September 10, South Korea’s cumulative exports for the year have reached $728.56 billion, overtaking the full‑year export volume of 2025, which was $709.3 billion.

To date only the United States, China and Germany have achieved annual export totals above $1 trillion; if South Korea becomes the fourth country to do so, the ability of semiconductor exports to maintain strong growth will be a decisive factor.

With global AI infrastructure investment expected to keep rising in the second half of the year, whether semiconductor demand can sustain its current momentum will directly affect South Korea’s overall export performance.
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the main pillars behind the recent surge in South Korean semiconductor exports, both benefiting from AI‑driven HBM demand and higher memory‑chip prices.

Samsung’s semiconductor division posted first‑quarter revenue of 81.7 trillion won and operating profit of 53.7 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue rose further to 127.5 trillion won with operating profit of 89.2 trillion won.
For the first half of the year, Samsung’s semiconductor business generated revenue of 209.2 trillion won and operating profit of 142.9 trillion won.

SK Hynix reported first‑quarter revenue of 52.5763 trillion won and operating profit of 37.6103 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue increased to 79.3187 trillion won with operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won.
For the first half, SK Hynix’s cumulative revenue was 131.895 trillion won, operating profit 98.1529 trillion won, yielding an operating margin of 76.3%.
KB Securities said that with memory‑chip prices rising and HBM supply expanding, Samsung has entered a phase of rapid earnings growth.

KB Securities research head Kim Dong‑won noted that under the current three‑year shareholder‑return plan, Samsung plans a 30‑trillion‑won cash dividend in Q3 and may further boost shareholder returns later this year through share buybacks, cancellations and additional cash dividends, with roughly 80 trillion won of usable funds remaining.
He added that Samsung’s upcoming new three‑year shareholder‑return policy could raise the dividend payout ratio, pushing the shareholder‑return rate above the current free‑cash‑flow level of 50%.
The semiconductor boom is spilling over to the equity market, with strong results from Samsung and SK Hynix drawing South Korean investors’ attention to semiconductor stocks.

FnGuide data show that from September 1‑7, Samsung was searched 1,672 times, the most‑searched stock among South Korean investors, while SK Hynix ranked second with 1,342 searches; the third‑most‑searched stock, Hyundai Motor, recorded 679 searches, a clear gap from the two semiconductor giants.
Optimism in the semiconductor market is also extending overseas. U.S. investment bank Piper Sandler upgraded AMD to an “overweight” rating and set a target price of $600.

In addition, South Korea’s biotech sector is attracting interest. Alteogen, the largest KOSDAQ‑listed company by market cap, signed an exclusive licensing agreement with Swiss pharma giant Novartis to grant Novartis use of its ALT‑B4 platform.

Um Min‑yong, an analyst at Shinhan Securities, said this is Novartis’s first collaboration to convert a gene‑therapy product into a subcutaneous injection, with the licensing scope exceeding market expectations and expanding the business from oncology drugs to new therapeutic modalities; he subsequently raised Alteogen’s target price to 540,000 won.

Overall, AI demand is becoming a major driver of South Korea’s export growth. As demand for high‑value‑added semiconductor products such as HBM rises, the share of semiconductors in South Korean exports continues to climb, amplifying its impact on the country’s economy and capital markets.

items.title: 搶攻AI與電力人才！台電獎學金招考11類科 大學碩士生最高可拿40萬
items.title_en: Taiwan Power Company Offers Scholarships to Attract AI and Power Industry Talent, Up to NT$400,000 for Graduate Students
paras: 招考台電獎學金剩倒數6天。因應產業民生經濟用電需求，台電持續推動電源與電網等多元電力建設，今年大學及研究所獎學金甄選大舉招考11類科，合計釋出70個名額，網路報名於本周9月18日截止。錄取者大學部最高可領24萬，碩士生最高可領40萬元獎學金，並於寒暑假提供實習機會，畢業後更可直接進台電工作，實現畢業即就業。

台電表示，因應廣納電力領域人才需求，本次獎學金甄選除了「保健物理/放射化學」、「電網規劃分析與控制運轉」、「電驛」等固定考科外，亦同步招考「智慧配電物聯網」、「通訊工程」、「地質模擬與風險分析」、「核工」、「網路資通訊安全」、「人工智慧、數據與資訊應用」、「電力電子」及「高壓工程」等，總計11類科、70個名額。所有類科皆開放碩士班學生報名，部分類科亦開放大學3年級與4年級學生報考，展現擴大選才方針。
台電指出，本次甄選初試將於10月31日舉行，包含筆試、資格審查及面試三個階段。錄取後每學期會評核學生學業成績，符合資格者，大學部每學期可領取6萬元獎學金，在學期間最高可領24萬元；研究所碩士生每學期則可領取10萬元，在學期間最高可領40萬元。錄取者於寒暑假期間可至公司實習，畢業後可直接進入台電服務。
台電補充，本月起已陸續召開多場實體說明會，相關錄影、簡報及詳細應考資格、考試科目等資訊均已公開於甄選網站（https://service.taipower.com.tw/scholarship/）。民眾如有疑義，亦可直接洽詢試務處專線（02-2366-7333）或透過電子郵件（d0960101@taipower.com.tw）進行聯繫。
paras_en: The application period for the Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) scholarship is down to its final six days. In response to the growing demand for electricity in industry, daily life, and the economy, Taipower continues to promote diverse power generation and grid projects. This year the scholarship selection opens 11 fields of study, releasing a total of 70 slots, with online registration closing on September 18. Successful undergraduate recipients can receive up to NT$240,000, while graduate students can receive up to NT$400,000, and both groups are offered internship opportunities during winter and summer breaks. After graduation, scholars can directly join Taipower, achieving employment upon graduation.

Taipower explained that to meet its broad talent needs in the power sector, the scholarship now includes, in addition to the regular subjects of "Health Physics/Radiation Chemistry," "Power Grid Planning, Analysis and Control Operations," and "Power Station," new fields such as "Smart Distribution IoT," "Communication Engineering," "Geological Simulation and Risk Analysis," "Nuclear Engineering," "Network and Information Security," "Artificial Intelligence, Data and Information Applications," "Power Electronics," and "High‑Voltage Engineering," making a total of 11 subjects and 70 positions. All subjects are open to master's‑level students, and some are also open to third‑ and fourth‑year undergraduates, reflecting an expanded recruitment policy.

Taipower noted that the preliminary exam for this selection will be held on October 31 and will consist of a written test, qualification review, and interview. After admission, students' academic performance will be evaluated each semester. Eligible undergraduates can receive NT$60,000 per semester, up to a maximum of NT$240,000 during their studies; master's students can receive NT$100,000 per semester, up to a maximum of NT$400,000. Selected scholars may intern at the company during winter and summer breaks and can join Taipower directly after graduation.

Taipower added that, starting this month, several in‑person briefing sessions have been held, and related videos, presentations, detailed eligibility criteria, and exam subjects are all posted on the selection website (https://service.taipower.com.tw/scholarship/). The public may also contact the examination office directly at 02‑2366‑7333 or via email at d0960101@taipower.com.tw for any questions.

items.title: 黃崇仁告別式政商大咖、親友近千人弔祭  賴清德總統親蒞並頒褒揚令
items.title_en: Farewell ceremony for Huang Chong‑jen attended by nearly a thousand political and business leaders, friends and family; President Lai Ching‑te attends and presents commendation
paras: 力晶(5346-TW)集團創辦人黃崇仁於7月31日辭世，享壽78歲。今(12)日上午舉行告別式，總統賴清德親蒞致哀並頒褒揚令，政商名流與親友、部屬近千人出席弔祭，場面莊嚴盛大備極哀榮。
賴總統特別頒發褒揚令時表示，黃崇仁創辦力晶集團企業貢獻台灣經濟，並致力回饋社會、推動國際科技合作等事功，對黃崇仁直面逆境，在挫折中清償1200億元債務、帶領公司轉型再成功股票上市的不屈不撓以及看好台灣經濟在AI浪潮中起飛的遠見，深表敬佩並致哀思。
黃崇仁生前熱愛藝文，2004年創辦力晶文化基金會長期大力贊助國內外藝術團體來台演出。蜚聲國際的小提琴大師黃俊文，十二日特與國家交響樂團(NSO)十位音樂家組成的室內樂團，於告別式現場演奏表達感念。
paras_en: Founder of the Liching Group (5346‑TW), Huang Chong‑jen, passed away on July 31 at the age of 78. This morning (the 12th) a farewell ceremony was held, attended by President Lai Ching‑te who offered condolences and presented a commendation order. Close to a thousand political and business figures, relatives, friends and former staff gathered to mourn, creating a solemn and grand atmosphere of both grief and honor.

President Lai, while presenting the commendation, said that Huang Chong‑jen founded the Liching Group, contributing to Taiwan’s economy and dedicating himself to social welfare and international technology cooperation. Lai praised Huang’s resilience in confronting adversity, repaying NT$120 billion of debt, leading the company’s transformation and successful stock listing, and his foresight in seeing Taiwan’s economy take off in the AI wave, expressing deep respect and sorrow.

Huang Chong‑jen was a lifelong patron of the arts. In 2004 he established the Liching Cultural Foundation, which has long sponsored domestic and overseas artistic groups performing in Taiwan. Internationally renowned violinist Huang Jun‑wen, together with a chamber ensemble of ten musicians from the National Symphony Orchestra, performed at the ceremony to express their gratitude.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉光罩爆量周漲23.7% 創兩個月來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Mask Wafer Surges 23.7% This Week to a Two-Month High
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)本周宣布與艾司摩爾(ASML-US)共同推進High NA EUV技術與12吋光罩，並點出曝光的光罩層數會同步增加，隨著光罩消耗產能增加，也引發外界對於擴大外包既有製程光罩的想像，推升台灣光罩(2338-TW)本周股價強漲23.7%，創下兩個月來新高。
台積電過去曾多次指出，ASML High NA EUV技術成本高昂。業界指出，由於ASML現階段採用6吋光罩，單次光罩的曝光面積相對有限，但現階段隨著晶片尺寸越變越大，須採用兩張6吋光罩進行拼接，也導致產量與時間受限。
不過，台積電與ASML共同宣布，將在後續導入12吋光罩，可望進一步滿足市場對面積更大晶片的需求，同時產出也將進一步提升，台積電更一改過往態度，直接宣布將於2030年起在先進製程中導入High NA EUV技術，並計畫在2031年前建立12吋光罩的試產線，為2033年12吋光罩的High NV EUV量產奠定基礎。
隨著台積電擴大12吋High NA EUV光罩的布局，市場看好，在尺寸變大、曝光層數增加情況下，對光罩產能消耗將增加，有機會擴大外包效應，而光罩原先即是台積電外包光罩的供應商，本周在資金提前卡位下，股價強漲23%，明顯優於大盤表現，不過，業界也提醒，仍須留意後續實際的外包效應以及營運動能。觀察三大法人動向，外資逢高出貨2,187張，自營商則小買13張。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) announced this week that it will jointly advance High‑NA EUV technology with ASML (ASML‑US) and 12‑inch mask wafers, noting that the number of layers in the exposure masks will increase. As mask consumption capacity rises, speculation about expanding outsourced existing process mask production has surged, driving TSMC’s mask wafer (2338‑TW) stock up 23.7% this week to a two‑month high.

TSMC has repeatedly pointed out that ASML’s High‑NA EUV technology is costly. The industry notes that ASML currently uses 6‑inch masks, limiting the exposure area per mask. As chip sizes grow, two 6‑inch masks must be stitched together, which restricts yield and time.

However, TSMC and ASML jointly announced that 12‑inch masks will be introduced later, expected to meet market demand for larger chips and further boost output. TSMC has also reversed its previous stance, declaring that it will adopt High‑NA EUV technology in advanced processes from 2030 and plans to establish a 12‑inch mask pilot line before 2031, laying the groundwork for 12‑inch High‑NA EUV mass production in 2033.

With TSMC expanding its 12‑inch High‑NA EUV mask layout, the market is optimistic. As chip size increases and exposure layers rise, mask capacity consumption will grow, potentially expanding outsourcing effects. The mask supplier, originally an outsourced provider for TSMC, saw its stock jump 23% this week, outperforming the market. Industry observers caution that actual outsourcing impact and operational momentum should still be monitored. Looking at the three major institutional flows, foreign investors sold 2,187 shares at high prices, while proprietary traders bought 13 shares.

items.title: 從產線到舞台！2026日月光好聲音各廠區員工同台獻唱
items.title_en: From Production Line to Stage! 2026 Sunshine Good Voice Show Features Employees from All Facilities Singing Together
paras: 日月光投控(3711-TW)(ASX-US)旗下日月光文教基金會與日月光集團聯合職工福利委員會於昨(11)日共同主辦「2026 日月光好聲音」，今年賽事吸引台灣區297位同仁報名，19位選手晉級決賽，最終由姜宛林奪下華語組冠軍、Timothy John Cachero拿下外語組冠軍。
「日月光好聲音」是「2026 日月光音樂季」的年度系列活動之一，期望透過這場賽事，提供專業的指導與陪伴，讓同仁在工作之餘有一個展現自己的舞台，同時也讓外界看見半導體廠不一樣的一面。
日月光文教基金會董事長吳田玉表示，外界常覺得半導體封測廠的生活就是上班下班、輪班、加班，其實日月光全球近十萬名同仁，不少人平常就很會唱歌，只是沒有機會讓別人看見。好聲音安排一對一指導和樂團彩排，就是希望給他們一個平台，在專業的舞台上好好唱一首自己喜歡的歌，也透過全程直播，縮短外籍同仁與家人的距離。

297位同仁報名 各廠區選手同台競演

這項賽事自2022年起由高雄廠舉辦，今年邁入第五屆。日月光文教基金會長期投入藝文推廣，看見廠內同仁在工作之餘能積極展現自己的興趣，決定今年把賽事擴大至全台灣，讓日月光中壢廠、矽品精密及環旭電子的同仁也能參加。賽事分華語組與外語組，晉級決賽的19位選手分別來自各廠區，其中10位為本國籍同仁、9位為外籍同仁，是各廠區同仁首次站上同一個舞台競技。
7月起，晉級選手利用週末往返高雄與台中，接受專業歌唱老師一對一指導，8月起再與伴奏樂團進行兩次現場彩排。冠軍可獲得獎金2萬元、亞軍1萬5千元、季軍1萬元。

決賽當天 家人到場 海外同步直播

決賽當天，選手的親友團到場加油。針對家鄉遠在數千公里之外的外籍同仁們，日月光也特別安排全程線上直播，讓身處海外的親友也能同步收看比賽實況。
活動主辦人日月光高雄廠處長林挺生表示：每年「日月光好聲音」的舞台上，都有許多令人感動的故事。過去曾有一名菲律賓籍同仁，在家鄉原是職業歌手，卻因嗓音受傷不得不放棄歌唱夢想，來台工作後，意外透過「日月光好聲音」重新站上舞台，並一舉奪得冠軍。領獎時，他更邀請太太與孩子一同上台，共享這份得來不易的榮耀，讓現場許多人深受感動。
另一名菲律賓籍女同仁則選唱《A Million Dreams》，將歌曲獻給遠在家鄉的孩子。她期盼透過在台灣努力工作，為孩子創造更好的生活與未來。對她而言，歌聲不只是表演，更承載著對家人的思念與對未來的期待。
林挺生指出，對許多第一線同仁，尤其是遠離家鄉來台工作的外籍同仁而言，平日在生產線上默默付出，未必有機會被大家看見，「日月光好聲音」希望做的，正是提供一個讓同仁展現自我、讓自己的聲音被聽見的舞台。許多參賽同仁也從這個舞台出發，陸續受邀參與文教基金會舉辦的年度慈善同樂會，公司尾牙及活動演出，從生產線上的工作夥伴，成為舞台上發光發熱的焦點。
林挺生分享，曾有外籍同仁告訴我，這一切就像做了一場很甜蜜的夢。能讓公司的董事長、總經理、主管以及自己的家人，看見自己站在舞台上的另一面，是許多同仁過去未曾想像的經驗；而這份被看見、被肯定與被鼓勵的感受，也正是「日月光好聲音」最珍貴的意義之一。
paras_en: Sunshine Investment Holding (3711-TW)(ASX-US) and its Sunshine Cultural Education Foundation, together with the Sunshine Group Joint Employee Welfare Committee, jointly organized the "2026 Sunshine Good Voice" event on November 11. This year’s competition attracted 297 employees from Taiwan, with 19 finalists advancing to the final round. Jiang Wanlin won the Mandarin category, while Timothy John Cachero claimed the foreign language category.

The "Sunshine Good Voice" is one of the annual series events of the "2026 Sunshine Music Season". It aims to provide professional guidance and support, giving employees a stage to showcase themselves beyond work, and allowing the outside world to see a different side of semiconductor plants.

Chairman Wu Tianyu of the Sunshine Cultural Education Foundation said that outsiders often think life at a semiconductor test plant is just work, shift, overtime. In reality, Sunshine’s nearly 100,000 employees worldwide often sing well but lack opportunities to be seen. The Good Voice program offers one‑on‑one coaching and band rehearsals, giving them a platform to perform a favorite song on a professional stage, and through live streaming it shortens the distance between foreign employees and their families.

With 297 applicants, competitors from each facility performed together on stage. Since 2022, the event has been hosted by the Kaohsiung plant and is now in its fifth year. The foundation’s long‑term investment in arts and culture led to expanding the competition nationwide this year, allowing participants from the Zhongli, Silgan Precision, and Huanxu Electronics plants to join. The competition is divided into Mandarin and foreign language categories; the 19 finalists come from various plants, with 10 local and 9 foreign employees—marking the first time employees from all facilities compete on the same stage.

Starting in July, finalists travel between Kaohsiung and Taichung on weekends to receive one‑on‑one coaching from professional vocal teachers, and from August they rehearse twice with an accompanying band. Winners receive a prize of 20,000 NT dollars for first place, 15,000 NT for second, and 10,000 NT for third.

On the day of the final, friends and family of the contestants came to cheer. For foreign employees whose hometowns are thousands of kilometers away, Sunshine arranged a full online live broadcast so overseas relatives could watch the live event in real time.

The event organizer, Kaohsiung plant director Lin Ting‑sheng, said that every year the "Sunshine Good Voice" stage hosts many touching stories. Previously, a Filipino employee who had been a professional singer in his hometown but had to give up his dream due to vocal injury found a new stage through the event and won the championship. He invited his wife and child to share the hard‑earned glory, moving many in the audience.

Another Filipino female employee sang "A Million Dreams," dedicating the song to her children back home. She hopes that by working hard in Taiwan she can create a better life and future for them. For her, singing is not just a performance but also a way to express longing for family and hope for the future.

Lin Ting‑sheng noted that for many frontline employees, especially foreign workers far from home, daily quiet contributions on the production line may go unnoticed. "Sunshine Good Voice" aims to provide a stage where employees can show themselves and have their voices heard. Many participants have since been invited to the foundation’s annual charity gala, company year‑end parties, and other performances, turning from production line teammates into shining stage highlights.

Lin shared that a foreign employee once told him this experience felt like a sweet dream. Seeing the chairman, general manager, supervisors, and family witness another side of him was an experience many employees had never imagined. The feeling of being seen, affirmed, and encouraged is one of the most precious meanings of "Sunshine Good Voice."

items.title: 〈熱門股〉運錩營運亮眼 8月以來大漲4成創逾4年波段新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Yungpan’s Operations Shine, Shares Surge 40% Since August to New Four‑Year High
paras: 不銹鋼加工廠運錩(2069-TW)受惠營運表現亮眼，推升股價大幅走揚，周五最高來到 25.2 元，創2022年6月以來逾 4 年波段新高，周漲幅達 17%，8 月以來更是大漲逾 4 成。
運錩 8 月營收 8.87 億元，月增 11.3%、年增 18.9%；累計前 8 月營收 66.83 億元，年減幅收斂至 3.2%。上半年受惠高附加價值產品比重提升，毛利率跳升至 14.66%（年增 5.24 個百分點），每股純益（EPS）達 1.66 元，已賺贏去年一整年。
運錩子公司寧波奇億受惠 3C 電子領域需求大幅增加，帶動高精密不鏽鋼冷軋產品出貨，成功優化產品結構；加上台灣加工業務持穩，共同推升整體營運表現。若以第二季營收比重來看，加工物流佔比提升至 44%，電子零組件則約佔 17%。
隨著寧波奇億新增產線設備持續上線、產品組合持續優化，運錩也看好下半年營運表現。此外，不銹鋼價8-9月重啟漲勢，也可望進一步挹注運錩獲利表現。
paras_en: Yungpan Steel Processing (2069‑TW) benefited from strong operational performance, driving its stock price sharply higher. On Friday, the share peaked at 25.2 NTD, a new four‑year high since June 2022, with a weekly gain of 17% and a rise of more than 40% since August.

Yungpan’s August revenue was 887 million NTD, up 11.3% month‑on‑month and 18.9% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue through August totaled 6.683 billion NTD, a year‑on‑year decline of only 3.2%. In the first half, the higher proportion of high‑value‑added products lifted the gross margin to 14.66% (an increase of 5.24 percentage points), and earnings per share reached 1.66 NTD, surpassing last year’s total earnings.

Yungpan’s subsidiary, Ningbo Qiyi, benefited from a sharp increase in demand in the 3C electronics sector, boosting shipments of high‑precision cold‑rolled stainless steel products and successfully optimizing its product mix. Combined with stable Taiwanese processing operations, this helped lift overall performance. In terms of second‑quarter revenue composition, processing logistics accounted for 44% and electronic components about 17%.

With Ningbo Qiyi’s new production line equipment coming online and its product mix continuing to improve, Yungpan is optimistic about its second‑half performance. Additionally, the resumption of stainless‑steel price gains in August‑September is expected to further support Yungpan’s profitability.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉油價又破百！00642U飆漲衝新高、00673R逆勢吸金額度面臨告罄
items.title_en: Hot Stocks: Oil Prices Break $100 Again! 00642U Soars to New High, 00673R Attracts Funds Amid Near Exhaustion
paras: 美伊衝突再升溫，繼美軍摧毀伊朗原油運輸船，伊朗隨即反擊，風險升溫推動國際油價突破每桶百美元。11 日期元大S&P石油(00642U-TW)大漲近6%，股價衝至33.49元新高價，本周累計漲幅10.64%；逆勢交易熱度亦同步攀升，期元大S&P原油反1(00673R-TW)吸引資金進場，11 日爆出逾 12.2 萬張大量，申購額度面臨告罄。
今年以來地緣政治風險頻繁，推升國際油價走勢，00642U今年以來至10日，累積報酬已達123.75%，居原型ETF市場之冠。與此同時，積極型投資人看好油價創高後回落態勢，資金逆勢湧入國內唯一油價反向商品期00673R。統計9月美伊衝突升溫至今，短短5個交易日內，累積淨申購金額旋即突破33.5億元，居期信ETF之冠。
根據元大投信官網顯示，截至9/10 00673R估算剩下約30億元申購量，已接近可發行額度上限，反映積極資金湧入，布局油價回落的投資機會。
法人分析，中東航運受阻若持續，將影響原油出口與運輸效率，市場對供應短缺的疑慮不易快速消退，加上中國原油採購增溫，8月原油進口量月增6.2%，油價短期仍維持高檔震盪。
不過，法人也提醒，期貨ETF與反向型ETF主要作為短線交易工具，投資人高度關注地緣政治風險導致價格反轉，同時亦需關注ETF市價與淨值間的折溢價變化，進場前宜審慎評估交易成本與價格波動風險。

paras_en: The US‑Iran conflict has escalated again, following the US military’s destruction of an Iranian oil transport vessel and Iran’s retaliation, raising risks and pushing international oil prices above $100 per barrel. On the 11th, Yuantai S&P Oil (00642U‑TW) surged nearly 6%, reaching a new high of 33.49 NT$ and a cumulative weekly gain of 10.64%; counter‑trend trading also intensified, as Yuantai S&P Oil Reverse (00673R‑TW) attracted capital, with over 122,000 contracts issued on the 11th and subscription limits approaching exhaustion.

Since the start of the year, geopolitical risks have frequently spiked, driving international oil prices higher. 00642U has delivered a cumulative return of 123.75% up to the 10th, topping the original‑ETF market. Meanwhile, active investors, optimistic about a rebound after the oil price peak, have poured money into the only domestic oil‑reverse commodity ETF, 00673R. Statistics show that since the US‑Iran conflict intensified in September, net subscription amounts have surged to 3.35 billion NT$ in just five trading days, leading the ETF‑based futures market.

According to Yuantai Investment Trust’s website, as of September 10, 00673R had an estimated remaining subscription volume of about 3 billion NT$, close to the issuance limit, reflecting strong inflows and positioning for a potential oil price pullback.

Corporate analysts say that if Middle‑Eastern shipping disruptions persist, they will affect crude oil exports and transport efficiency, making supply‑shortage concerns hard to dispel quickly. Coupled with increased Chinese crude purchases, August crude imports rose 6.2% month‑on‑month, keeping oil prices in short‑term high‑range volatility.

However, analysts also caution that futures ETFs and inverse ETFs are primarily short‑term trading tools. Investors should closely monitor geopolitical risk‑driven price reversals and the premium/discount between ETF market price and NAV, and carefully assess transaction costs and price‑volatility risk before entering.
