items.title: 上櫃公司前8月營收衝上2.55兆元！三大產業領跑8月營收年增近5成
items.title_en: OTC Companies' Revenue Surges to 2.55 Trillion NTD in the First Eight Months of 2025, with Three Industries Leading August's Revenue Growth of Nearly 50%
paras: 櫃買中心統計，891家上櫃公司115年8月單月營收總計3644億元，較114年同期大幅成長1169億元，年增率高達47%；前8月累計營收達2兆5514億元，年增5957億元，年增率30%。受惠AI應用、高階記憶體及AI伺服器需求強勁，半導體業、電腦及周邊設備業與電子零組件業成為拉動營收衝高的大功臣，顯示上櫃公司整體基本面表現穩健且動能強勁。
櫃買中心表示，截至115年9月10日，891家上櫃公司（含30家KY公司）已全部完成8月營收申報作業。8月單月營收成長公司多達641家，衰退247家，持平3家。累計前8月營收成長公司亦達629家，顯示多數公司均受惠於產業復甦與市場需求升溫。
從單月產業表現來看，8月帶動成長的主力集中在科技供應鏈，且單月無任何產業出現衰退。其中半導體業8月營收高達1038億元，年增509億元，暴增96%，主因受惠於AI應用擴大及高階記憶體需求持續爆發；電腦及周邊設備業8月營收393億元，年增162億元，成長70%，同樣受惠AI浪潮；電子零組件業則在AI伺服器及高階產品需求升溫下，8月營收達365億元，年增94億元，成長35%。
在累計營收方面，前8月主要成長產業為半導體業（累計6761億元，年增65%）、電腦及周邊設備業（累計2685億元，年增46%）以及其他電子業（累計1897億元，年增38%）。其他電子業主要受益於AI伺服器散熱需求暢旺與貴金屬價格上漲等雙重利多加持。
相對地，前8月累計營收呈現衰退的產業主要為建材營造、運動休閒及紡織纖維。其中建材營造累計營收545億元，年減9%，主要受建案完工交屋進度影響收入認列時間；運動休閒累計營收200億元，年減3%，受到新品推出與客戶拉貨排程調整影響；紡織纖維累計營收110億元，年減4%，則受到部分公司接單策略調整及營運轉型期所致。相關詳細彙總數據，投資人可至公開資訊觀測站查詢。
paras_en: The OTC Center reports that 891 listed companies generated a total revenue of 364.4 billion NTD in August 2025, up 116.9 billion NTD from the same month in 2024, a year‑on‑year increase of 47%. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached 2.5514 trillion NTD, up 595.7 billion NTD from the previous year, a 30% year‑on‑year growth. Strong demand for AI applications, high‑end memory, and AI servers has propelled the semiconductor, computer and peripheral equipment, and electronic component sectors to become the main drivers of the revenue surge, demonstrating robust fundamentals and strong momentum for OTC companies.

The OTC Center announced that as of September 10, 2025, all 891 listed companies (including 30 KY companies) had completed their August revenue filings. A total of 641 companies saw revenue growth in August, 247 declined, and 3 remained flat. Cumulative revenue growth companies for the first eight months totaled 629, indicating that most companies benefited from industry recovery and rising market demand.

In terms of monthly industry performance, August’s growth was concentrated in the technology supply chain, with no industry experiencing a decline. The semiconductor sector posted August revenue of 103.8 billion NTD, up 50.9 billion NTD, a 96% jump, driven by expanding AI applications and sustained high‑end memory demand. The computer and peripheral equipment sector generated 39.3 billion NTD, up 16.2 billion NTD, a 70% increase, also buoyed by the AI wave. The electronic component sector, benefiting from rising demand for AI servers and high‑end products, achieved 36.5 billion NTD, up 9.4 billion NTD, a 35% rise.

For cumulative revenue, the leading growth sectors in the first eight months were semiconductors (6.761 trillion NTD, 65% YoY growth), computer and peripheral equipment (2.685 trillion NTD, 46% YoY growth), and other electronics (1.897 trillion NTD, 38% YoY growth). The other electronics sector benefited from robust AI server cooling demand and rising precious metal prices.

Conversely, the sectors that declined in cumulative revenue over the first eight months were construction materials, sports and leisure, and textiles and fibers. Construction materials saw cumulative revenue of 54.5 billion NTD, down 9% YoY, mainly due to delays in project completion and handover affecting revenue recognition timing. Sports and leisure recorded 20.0 billion NTD, down 3% YoY, impacted by new product launches and customer order scheduling adjustments. Textiles and fibers reported 11.0 billion NTD, down 4% YoY, due to some companies adjusting order strategies and undergoing operational transformation. Investors can find detailed summary data on the Open Information Observation Station.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro系列在中國正式預售 開售數分鐘首批貨源賣光
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Series Begins Pre‑sale in China, First Stock Sells Out Within Minutes
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone 18 Pro系列12日（周六）晚8點正式啟動預售，開售僅數分鐘，蘋果中國官網、淘寶、京東等主流電商平台多個熱門型號首批貨源相繼售罄。
冰川藍色iPhone 18 Pro及 iPhone 18 Pro Max的256GB、512GB、1TB在蘋果官網預計發貨時間均已推遲至9月30日。
據《科創板日報》報導，今天下午，深圳一家蘋果授權店iPhone 18 Pro系列的登記預訂量已有五六十單，預訂無需支付定金，門市採取「到貨後按登記順序通知」 方式發售。
店員說，在顏色偏好方面，登記預訂的消費者中，選擇藍色與酒紅色兩款配色的人數最多。
值得一提的是，首批貨源快速消化，部分急於第一時間入手新機的消費者，開始轉向第三方渠道求購，iPhone 18 Pro 系列的市場成交價格也隨之出現波動。
在得物App上，iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB勃艮第酒紅色成交均價為人民幣（下同）12,799元，大漲1,800元，漲幅16.4%；同為256GB的銀色版本成交均價達到13,999元，漲了3,000元，漲幅27.3%。
iPhone 18 Pro價格上漲幅度相對較小。256GB勃艮第酒紅色和銀色版本成交均價均為10,999元，漲1000元，漲幅10.0%；冰川藍色256GB成交均價為11,499元，漲1,500元，漲幅15.0%。1TB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交均價為16,699元，漲1,200元，漲幅7.7%。
高容量版本的市場價格同樣出現上漲。iPhone 18 Pro Max冰川藍色1TB成交均價為18,299元，漲1,800元，漲幅10.9%；黑色2TB成交均價達到24,700元，漲3,201元，漲幅14.9%。
在得物App首輪預售成交數量中，iPhone 18 Pro Max和iPhone 18 Pro的256GB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交數量最多，是目前成交熱度最高的機型。
手機渠道商家表示，今年首批市場價格是否會持續處於高檔，需要觀察後續供給。
該商家說，從產品變化來看，iPhone 18 Pro系列此次升級更多集中在晶片、通訊、續航散熱、影像等內部能力，外觀整體變化相對有限，消費者對部分升級的直觀感知可能並不強。
與此同時，新機價格上漲也進一步提高渠道商的備貨成本和囤貨風險，部分商家對首批新機的收貨相對謹慎。
該商家提到：「蘋果的產能爬升速度比較快，發售後三到四周供給會明顯增加。剛開始貨少，現貨價格會高一點，隨著貨源陸續進入市場，價格一般會在10月中下旬進入相對穩定階段。」
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched the pre‑sale of the iPhone 18 Pro series at 8 p.m. on Saturday, the 12th. Within minutes the first batches of several popular models on Apple’s China website, Taobao, JD.com and other major e‑commerce platforms sold out.
The Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in 256 GB, 512 GB and 1 TB configurations have had their estimated shipping dates on Apple’s website pushed back to September 30.

According to the Science‑Innovation Board Daily, an Apple‑authorized store in Shenzhen reported this afternoon that it had already received fifty‑to‑sixty registration orders for the iPhone 18 Pro series. No deposit is required for registration, and the store will notify customers in registration order once the devices arrive.
The sales staff said that among the registered customers, the blue and burgundy color options were the most popular.

It is worth noting that the rapid sell‑through of the first stock prompted some eager buyers to turn to third‑party channels, causing market transaction prices for the iPhone 18 Pro series to fluctuate.
On the Dewu app, the average transaction price for the 256 GB iPhone 18 Pro Max in Burgundy rose to ¥12,799, up ¥1,800 or 16.4%. The 256 GB silver version averaged ¥13,999, up ¥3,000 or 27.3%.

The iPhone 18 Pro saw smaller price increases. Both the 256 GB Burgundy and silver versions averaged ¥10,999, up ¥1,000 (10.0%). The 256 GB Glacier‑blue averaged ¥11,499, up ¥1,500 (15.0%). The 1 TB Burgundy version averaged ¥16,699, up ¥1,200 (7.7%).
High‑capacity models also rose in price. The 1 TB Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro Max averaged ¥18,299, up ¥1,800 (10.9%). The 2 TB black version averaged ¥24,700, up ¥3,201 (14.9%).

In the first round of pre‑sale transactions on Dewu, the 256 GB Burgundy versions of both iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro recorded the highest sales volumes, making them the hottest models so far.
Channel merchants said it remains to be seen whether the initial market prices will stay high this year, depending on subsequent supply.

The merchant noted that the iPhone 18 Pro series upgrades focus more on internal capabilities such as the chip, communications, battery life, thermal management and imaging, with relatively limited exterior changes, so consumers may not perceive the upgrades strongly.
At the same time, the price hikes increase merchants’ inventory costs and stocking risks, leading some to be cautious about receiving the first batch of new phones.

The merchant added: “Apple’s production ramp‑up is relatively fast; supply will increase noticeably three to four weeks after launch. Early on, limited stock drives higher spot prices, but as inventory flows into the market, prices should stabilize around mid‑to‑late October.”

items.title: 蘋果CEO特努斯談iPhone Duo：「軟硬體一體」才是摺疊螢幕核心
items.title_en: Apple CEO Ternus on iPhone Duo: "Hardware‑Software Integration" Is the Core of Foldable Screens
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊 iPhone 正式亮相後，執行長特納斯（John Ternus）與行銷資深副總裁Greg Joswiak接受媒體聯訪，談及這款新品的研發理念、設計方向、定價策略，以及蘋果如何在產品開發過程中維持機密。
根據《Tom's Guide》報導，特納斯表示，蘋果始終將產品品質、耐用度與設計標準視為推出新品的重要門檻，只有整體產品構想符合公司既定要求，才會正式推向市場。
他指出，iPhone Duo 專案讓團隊有機會從零開始探索新的產品形式，重新思考硬體、軟體及整體產品形態，並藉由軟硬體整合打造最終產品。
Joswiak表示，蘋果曾研究市場上現有的摺疊手機，認為部分產品在設計上存在較強的「拼接感」，因此團隊希望透過不同的螢幕比例與軟體體驗，讓 iPhone Duo 建立自身特色。
iPhone Duo 採用 1:1.4 的螢幕比例，同時重新設計軟體使用體驗，以配合摺疊形態。
針對摺疊螢幕常見的手感問題，蘋果在內螢幕表層採用聚合物材質，並自行開發奈米紋理表面工藝，改善螢幕表面的平整度與觸控手感，同時提升耐用性。
特納斯指出，部分市售摺疊裝置的螢幕存在觸感偏向塑膠、表面褶皺起伏等問題，而蘋果開發的奈米紋理工藝，就是希望針對這些問題進行改善。
摺疊 iPhone 的相關消息早已在產品正式發表前曝光，部分產品規格也提前流出。對此，兩名蘋果高層也談到 iPhone Duo 在研發期間採取的保密措施。
特納斯與Joswiak表示，為保護核心技術，iPhone Duo 專案使用與產品無直接關聯的內部代號，並強化整個開發流程的保密管理。
雖然螢幕比例等資訊提前曝光，但可摺疊奈米紋理顯示螢幕這項核心技術細節，仍成功維持到產品正式發表，成為此次研發保密工作的成果之一。
iPhone Duo 起跳價為1999美元，明顯高於一般智慧手機。對於產品定價，特納斯坦言價格確實較高，但蘋果團隊認為，其整體產品體驗具備相應價值。
Joswiak則解釋，iPhone Duo 的命名本身就反映產品定位，意在代表這款裝置整合兩類裝置的使用能力。
另一方面，剛接任蘋果執行長約一週的特納斯也談到履新後的感受。他表示，能夠接下蘋果發展的接力棒是一項莫大榮幸，自己半生職涯都在蘋果度過，對公司及研發團隊抱有深厚感情，也期待帶領團隊持續推動產品創新。
工程師出身的特納斯在產品溝通上的表現，也被形容較前任管理者更為外放。他回憶，在看到 iPhone Duo 的螢幕原型機時，就確認這是團隊希望打造的產品方向。
paras_en: After the official unveiling of Apple’s (AAPL-US) first foldable iPhone, CEO John Ternus and senior vice president of marketing Greg Joswiak fielded joint media questions, discussing the product’s development philosophy, design direction, pricing strategy, and how Apple maintains secrecy throughout the development process.

According to Tom’s Guide, Ternus said Apple always treats product quality, durability and design standards as critical thresholds for launching new items; only when the overall concept meets the company’s established criteria does it move to market.

He noted that the iPhone Duo project gave the team a chance to start from scratch and explore a new product form, re‑thinking hardware, software and the overall product shape, and to create the final device through tight hardware‑software integration.

Joswiak said Apple studied existing foldable phones on the market and found many of them suffered from a pronounced “joint” feel in their design, so the team aimed to give the iPhone Duo its own identity by using different screen ratios and software experiences.
The iPhone Duo uses a 1:1.4 screen ratio and features a redesigned software experience to suit its folding form factor.

To address common tactile issues with foldable displays, Apple applied a polymer coating to the inner screen surface and developed its own nano‑texture surface process, improving flatness, touch feel and durability.
Ternus pointed out that some commercial foldable devices have screens that feel plasticky and show surface creases, and Apple’s nano‑texture process was created specifically to remedy those problems.

News about the foldable iPhone had leaked before the official launch, with some specifications surfacing early; the two Apple executives also discussed the confidentiality measures taken during iPhone Duo’s development.

Ternus and Joswiak said that, to protect core technology, the iPhone Duo project used an internal code name unrelated to the product and tightened secrecy controls throughout the development workflow.

Although details such as the screen ratio were leaked early, the core technology of a foldable nano‑texture display remained concealed until the official announcement, marking a success of the secrecy effort.
The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, clearly higher than typical smartphones. On pricing, Ternus admitted the cost is indeed steep, but the Apple team believes the overall experience justifies the price.
Joswiak explained that the name iPhone Duo itself reflects the product’s positioning, intended to signify the device’s ability to combine the functions of two device categories.

Meanwhile, Ternus, who took over as Apple’s CEO about a week ago, spoke about his feelings after assuming the role, saying it is a great honor to inherit Apple’s development baton, that he has spent half his career at Apple, feels deep affection for the company and its R&D teams, and looks forward to leading continued product innovation.

Ternus, an engineer by training, is described as more outgoing in product communication than his predecessor; he recalled that when he saw the iPhone Duo screen prototype, he immediately confirmed it was the direction the team wanted to pursue.

items.title: OpenAI開放Agents API！Codex代理框架全面向開發者開放
paras: OpenAI正將支撐旗下程式設計代理Codex的底層技術進一步對外開放，將過去累積於內部產品與企業服務的人工智慧（AI）代理開發經驗，轉化為開發者可直接使用的API。
OpenAI近日宣布，Agents API正式進入公開測試階段，現在所有開發者均可使用。過去這套代理框架及相關基礎設施主要應用於Codex與企業版ChatGPT，如今則以API形式開放，開發者不需額外支付訂閱費，只須按照實際使用的token及工具呼叫量付費。
隨著Codex及ChatGPT for Work過去一年觸及全球數百萬名使用者，OpenAI在實際應用中發現，讓AI代理長時間執行複雜任務，單靠模型本身並不足夠。
代理還需要能夠管理上下文、使用工具、協調其他代理，以及在能讀寫檔案、執行程式碼並保存中間結果的環境中持續運作。
早期客戶的使用結果也顯示，這套架構已帶來一定效益。SafetyKit將案件審核流程移轉至Agents API後，單一案件的處理成本降低60%；Hypha透過將代理執行框架與沙箱環境分離，使代理回應失敗率降低86%；科技公司Cirridae的評估分數則由0.71提升至0.85，同時延遲降低4倍。

單次API呼叫即可建立長時間運作代理

Agents API的主要目的，是降低企業及開發者打造長時間運作AI代理所需的工程成本。
過去每當新的AI模型推出，開發者往往需要重新調整甚至重建自己的代理執行框架，才能使用模型新增的能力。
OpenAI希望透過版本化的Agents API，讓模型更新能直接對應相應的能力，而不必由開發者自行重新打造底層架構。
根據OpenAI的設計，開發者只要在API呼叫中指定任務、模型、工具及執行環境，即可建立可用於生產環境的代理，無須自行處理上下文管理及子代理協調等底層工作。
Agents API目前具備3項主要能力。
首先是自動壓縮上下文。當對話內容接近模型上下文容量上限時，系統會自動壓縮較早期的資訊，使代理能夠持續執行數小時甚至數天。
其次是工具搜尋與平行呼叫。系統可依照任務需求載入相關工具定義，降低token使用量，同時允許多項工具呼叫平行執行。
第三則是多代理協作。主要代理可以將複雜工作拆解後交給多個子代理平行處理，每個子代理各自維持上下文，再由主要代理整合最終結果。
物流科技公司Nash表示，目前透過Agents API部署數千個長時間運作的AI代理，用於管理全球數億次配送任務，單次代理執行時間可持續數小時甚至數天。

自託管沙箱與多家雲端業者提供部署選項

除了代理框架本身，Agents API也提供不同的執行環境選擇。
OpenAI提供自託管沙箱，並與Codex及ChatGPT採用相同的沙箱基礎設施，讓代理能夠快速啟動並進行彈性擴展。
此外，OpenAI已與Blaxel、Cloudflare、Daytona、DigitalOcean、E2B、Modal、甲骨文（Oracle）、Runloop及Vercel等合作夥伴進行一級整合，提供不同的部署選項，包括私有雲、特定儲存需求，以及不同CPU、GPU與記憶體配置。
OpenAI表示，這種架構可涵蓋從新創團隊快速驗證產品，到企業級正式部署等不同需求。
建築及居家服務AI平台Long Lake表示，透過Agents API，團隊目前可在數小時內將AI代理部署至不同產業，過去則可能需要數天。

開源Codex執行框架　模型升級可直接受惠

Agents API是建立在開源Codex執行框架之上，開發者可以透過公開程式碼庫了解模型呼叫、工具協調及上下文管理等核心運作方式。
OpenAI則負責持續維護及更新這套框架。換言之，當新模型推出時，開發者可直接取得更新後的能力，而不必自行重新設計整套代理架構。
OpenAI指出，Agents API目前仍處於公開測試階段，後續將根據開發者回饋持續調整，並朝正式發布推進。
在工具支援方面，Agents API支援MCP協定、自訂函式及網頁搜尋等內建工具。定價方面，API本身不另收訂閱費，開發者則依實際token消耗及工具使用量支付費用。

items.title: 「隨時聆聽」惹隱私爭議！Apple Watch新AI功能恐踩美竊聽法灰色地帶
items.title_en: “Always Listening” Sparks Privacy Controversy! Apple Watch’s New AI Feature May Tread a Legal Gray Area Under U.S. Eavesdropping Laws
paras: 蘋果公司(AAPL-US)近期推出的Apple Watch Series 12與Ultra 4手錶，搭載了可以「隨時聆聽」的人工智慧(AI)功能，儘管能帶來更便利的使用體驗，但也伴隨資料隱私疑慮，恐讓各州的竊聽法面臨新的法律考驗。
彭博報導，蘋果本周宣布推出的「Siri Recap」，可整理使用者全天對話內容並產生摘要，「Live Rewind」則能顯示使用者過去15秒所說內容的逐字轉錄，只要連按兩下Apple Watch錶冠即可啟動。
蘋果似乎意識到潛在問題，因此在公布這些功能時，強調多項隱私保護措施，包括使用者要求「Live Rewind」轉錄內容時會發出聲音提示、音訊在裝置端處理，以及強調原始音訊實際上並未被錄製或儲存。

連續處理語音是否構成「攔截」？

不過疑慮關鍵在於，即使裝置只是持續處理語音、沒有建立傳統的音訊檔案，這種行為是否仍可能按照各州法律，被視為「錄音」或「攔截」。
目前加州、麻薩諸塞州、賓州及華盛頓州的律師與法律專家，已經開始檢視這些隱私防護措施是否足以讓使用者免於潛在的法律問題。
波士頓刑事辯護律師Joe Simons認為，這些細節先前還沒有經過訴訟，並預測這種情況在麻州將成為「首宗判例」。賓州辯護律師Phil Lauer則表示，這項技術「非常接近合法，因為實際上並不是某個人接收並使用這些資料」，但「仍可以主張這是違法的」，因為裝置確實正在接收音訊並進行解讀。

AI裝置成為日常陪伴 竊聽疑慮升溫

科技巨頭投入大量資金製造及開發AI穿戴裝置之際，隱私疑慮也油然而生。這類產品被定位為使用者日常生活中的「常駐」工具，例如Meta Platforms(META-US)旗下熱門智慧眼鏡，就因可能遭到秘密錄音而引發反彈。
甚至還有專門設計用於錄音的AI裝置，例如Plaud與Pocket推出的產品。但關鍵差異在於，這些裝置只有在使用者按下按鈕後才會開始聆聽，而蘋果公司此次推出的功能，具備了持續聆聽的能力。
一名X用戶針對Live Rewind功能寫道：「監控現在變得更加普及。」
針對外界質疑，蘋果把「Siri Recap」與「Live Rewind」定位為幫助使用者喚回記憶的工具，而非用來建立詳細對話紀錄的功能。蘋果也表示，這些摘要會排除敏感資訊，例如財務細節、個人識別資訊及身分驗證資料。
然而，隨著涉及失控AI代理人的事件陸續發生，外界對AI安全防護機制的信任正在下降。在此背景下，Apple的新功能以及公司宣稱「沒有任何內容被錄製」的說法，也可能引發嚴重的安全疑慮。

專家：使用前最好先取得同意

Chandra Law Firm LLC創辦人暨管理合夥人Subodh Chandra表示，在使用這些AI新功能前，使用者最好先清楚了解相關法律，「我的建議是，把這項功能視為可能被法律認定為竊聽法規下的攔截，因此應該先取得同意」。
也有專家指出，使用者實際上可能沒有什麼方式可以同意或拒絕這項「錄音」功能。電子前線基金會(EFF)隱私訴訟主任Adam Schwartz說：「人們實際上沒有可行的方式來同意或拒絕錄音。我們建議人們在使用這項技術前三思，這是出於對他人對話隱私的尊重。」
蘋果則反駁這些功能並不屬於「錄製對話」，根據官方指引，使用者應「考量」身邊的人，尤其是在對話可能涉及隱私或敏感內容的情況下。
蘋果在聲明中表示，人們長期以來就有不同工具可以用來做筆記，包括手機與穿戴式裝置，因此新功能與這些工具並無不同。蘋果也表示，音訊是在安全硬體上處理，該硬體無法由作業系統、蘋果或其他任何人存取。
paras_en: Apple Inc. (AAPL-US) recently released the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, which include an AI capability that can “listen at any time.” While the feature promises greater convenience, it also raises data‑privacy concerns that could put state eavesdropping statutes to a new legal test.

Bloomberg reported that Apple announced this week a feature called “Siri Recap,” which compiles a day’s worth of user conversations into a summary, and a “Live Rewind” function that displays a verbatim transcript of what the user said in the past 15 seconds. Both are activated by double‑pressing the watch crown.

Apple appears aware of the potential issues, and when unveiling the features it highlighted several privacy safeguards, including an audible cue when a user requests a Live Rewind transcript, on‑device audio processing, and the claim that the raw audio is neither recorded nor stored.
Does continuous voice processing constitute “interception”?

The key concern is whether, even if the device only processes speech continuously without creating a traditional audio file, such activity might still be deemed a “recording” or “interception” under various state laws.

Boston criminal defense attorney Joe Simons says the details have not yet been litigated and predicts this could become the first precedent in Massachusetts. Pennsylvania defense lawyer Phil Lauer notes the technology is “very close to legal because no one is actually receiving and using the data,” yet “it can still be argued illegal” because the device does receive and interpret audio.

AI devices are becoming everyday companions, heightening eavesdropping worries. As tech giants pour money into AI wearables, privacy concerns naturally arise. These products are marketed as “resident” tools in users’ daily lives; for example, Meta Platforms’ (META-US) popular smart glasses have faced backlash over potential secret recordings.

There are even AI devices designed specifically for recording, such as those from Plaud and Pocket, which only start listening when the user presses a button. Apple’s new functions, by contrast, have continuous‑listening capability.
An X user wrote about the Live Rewind feature: “Surveillance is becoming more ubiquitous now.”

In response to criticism, Apple frames Siri Recap and Live Rewind as tools to help users recall memories rather than to create detailed conversation logs. The company also says the summaries will omit sensitive information such as financial details, personally identifying information, and authentication data.

However, as incidents involving out‑of‑control AI agents continue to surface, public trust in AI safety mechanisms is eroding. Against this backdrop, Apple’s new features and its claim that “no content is recorded” could raise serious security concerns.

Expert advice: obtain consent first. Subodh Chandra, founder and managing partner of Chandra Law Firm LLC, advises users to understand the relevant laws before using these AI features, saying, “My recommendation is to treat this feature as something that could be deemed interception under eavesdropping statutes, so you should obtain consent beforehand.”

Other experts note that users may have little practical way to consent to or reject this “recording” function. Adam Schwartz, privacy litigation director at the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), said, “People effectively have no viable way to consent to or reject recording. We recommend people think twice before using this technology, out of respect for others’ conversational privacy.”

Apple counters that these functions do not constitute “recording conversations.” According to official guidance, users should “consider” the people around them, especially when a conversation may involve private or sensitive content.

In its statement, Apple notes that people have long used various tools—phones and wearables included—to take notes, and that the new features are no different. Apple also says audio is processed on secure hardware that cannot be accessed by the operating system, Apple, or anyone else.

items.title: 邁威爾坐擁高度「黏著性」業務 有望解鎖300億美元商機
items.title_en: Marvell Leverages Highly "Sticky" Business, Poised to Unlock $30 B Opportunity
paras: 《MarketWatch》周五(11日)報導，邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)的客製化晶片與連接技術，使其成為資料中心建設熱潮的重要受益者之一。對此，一名分析師更將該公司譽為「多引擎成長加速」的模範。
邁威爾股價周五上漲4%，今年迄今已累計上漲近178%。
美銀分析師Vivek Arya表示，邁威爾面向資料中心連接的端到端產品組合「每年都能吸引更多客戶、增加更多產品」，他認為這將推動公司營收及每股盈餘快速成長。
Arya表示，相較於XPU業務，邁威爾認為其「XPU附加」業務的「黏著性更高」，意味著客戶會持續回購這些產品並加深使用。邁威爾將其客製化晶片稱為XPU，而支援這些晶片在資料中心運作的元件，例如網路與儲存控制器，則稱為XPU附加產品(XPU attach)。
Arya表示，如果每顆客製化晶片搭配一個或多個插槽——或處理器與其他元件連接的位置——且每個元件平均售價介於500至1,500美元之間，那麼邁威爾到2029年底可能從XPU附加業務取得300億美元營收。屆時，他預期支援晶片元件的整體潛在市場(TAM)將達600億至650億美元，甚至可能更高。
這名分析師指出，邁威爾預期其最大客製化晶片客戶亞馬遜雲端服務(AWS)將持續逐年成長。此外，邁威爾計劃從明年開始逐步提高與微軟合作的客製化產品產量。Arya認為，這將有助於邁威爾在客製化晶片市場提升市占率。他預期，到2029年底，包括晶片及其支援元件在內的客製化運算產品整體潛在市場，將達約3,000億美元。
另一方面，Arya表示，無論客戶選擇如何建置，邁威爾都有望在「垂直擴展」(scale-up)光學網路市場取得領先地位，原因在於公司擁有共封裝光學、近封裝光學以及近封裝光學元件等完整產品組合。擴展式網路技術可將多個處理器連接起來，發揮如同單一、更強大晶片般的效能。
Arya補充，邁威爾並不認為亞馬遜近期宣布與高通合作開發光學連接元件，會對其光學業務構成威脅。
該分析師維持對邁威爾股票的「買進」評級。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported on Friday the 11th that Marvell Technology’s (MRVL-US) custom chips and connectivity technology have made it one of the key beneficiaries of the data‑center build‑out boom. An analyst even called the company a model of “multi‑engine growth acceleration.”
Marvell’s shares rose 4% on Friday, up nearly 178% year‑to‑date.

Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya said Marvell’s end‑to‑end product portfolio for data‑center connectivity “attracts more customers and adds more products every year,” and he believes this will drive rapid revenue and EPS growth.

Arya noted that, compared with Marvell’s XPU business, its “XPU‑attach” offerings are “stickier,” meaning customers will keep repurchasing these products and deepen their usage. Marvell calls its custom chips XPUs, while the components that support those chips in data centers—such as networking and storage controllers—are termed XPU‑attach products.

Arya estimated that if each custom chip is paired with one or more slots—points where processors connect to other components—and each component sells for an average of $500 to $1,500, Marvell could generate $30 billion of revenue from XPU‑attach by the end of 2029. He expects the total addressable market for supporting chip components to reach $60 billion to $65 billion, or possibly higher.

The analyst pointed out that Marvell expects its biggest custom‑chip customer, Amazon Web Services (AWS), to keep growing year over year. Marvell also plans to gradually increase the volume of custom products it makes with Microsoft starting next year. Arya believes this will help Marvell lift its market share in the custom‑chip space, and he projects that by the end of 2029 the overall TAM for custom compute products—including chips and their supporting components—will be about $300 billion.

On the other hand, Arya said that regardless of how customers build their solutions, Marvell is well positioned to lead the “scale‑up” optical networking market because it offers a full suite of products such as co‑packaged optics, near‑package optics and near‑package optical components. Scale‑out networking can link multiple processors to act like a single, more powerful chip.
Arya added that Marvell does not see Amazon’s recent announcement of a partnership with Qualcomm to develop optical interconnect components as a threat to its own optical business.
The analyst maintains a “Buy” rating on Marvell stock.

items.title: 川習會前夕鬆口！川普表態不反對中國車廠赴美設廠 條件是雇用美國工人
items.title_en: On the Eve of the Trump‑Xi Summit, Trump Softens Stance: He Says He Won’t Oppose Chinese Car Makers Setting Up Plants in the U.S., Provided They Hire American Workers
paras: 在「川習會」預定兩周後於華盛頓登場之際，美國總統川普周五(11日)表示，即使美國國會議員及汽車業者普遍反對，他也不會反對中國汽車製造商赴美設廠生產汽車。
川普接受福斯新聞網(Fox News)節目「The Ingraham Angle」訪問時說：「如果中國想進來美國設廠生產汽車，我會接受。日本就是這麼做的，但他們雇用我們的人。最重要的是，他們雇用我們的人。」
川普補充說，他不希望中國汽車製造商在墨西哥生產汽車，再運往美國。他不忘解釋，「我不是在批評中國汽車」。

川普稱放行傳聞「完全是假消息」

美國密西根州民主黨籍參議員Elissa Slotkin周三表示，「有傳聞指出，川普正計劃允許中國汽車在美國銷售，作為他籌劃中一項更大協議的一部分。這將是戰略上的錯誤。」
川普駁斥Slotkin的說法「完全是假消息」，並表示自己一直將中國汽車擋在美國市場之外。
根據前總統拜登政府在2025年初實施的一項規定，美國實際上禁止所有中國車廠在美國銷售或生產乘用車。華府目前對中國電動車課徵超過100%的關稅。
美國汽車製造商已經公開敦促川普，不要同意讓中國汽車製造商進入美國市場。
代表通用(GM-US)、福特(F-US)、豐田(Toyots)、福斯(Volkswagen)、現代(Hyundai)、本田(Honda)、Stellantis(STLA-US)等大型汽車製造商的汽車創新聯盟(Alliance for Automotive Innovation)，敦促國會在12月底前，通過永久禁止中國汽車進入美國市場的法案。
該聯盟執行長John Bozzella在致國會領袖的信中指控，中國汽車製造商正利用補貼，在全球傾銷搭載聯網軟體與硬體的汽車。
paras_en: Trump said on Friday the 11th that even though most members of Congress and the auto industry oppose it, he will not block Chinese automobile manufacturers from building factories in the United States, just weeks before the Trump‑Xi meeting scheduled to take place in Washington.

In an interview on Fox News’ program “The Ingraham Angle,” Trump said, “If China wants to come to the United States and set up a plant to make cars, I’ll be fine with it. Japan does that, but they hire our people. The most important thing is they hire our people.”
Trump added that he does not want Chinese car makers to produce vehicles in Mexico and then ship them to the United States. He clarified, “I’m not criticizing Chinese cars.”

Trump called the rumor “totally fake news.” Michigan Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin said on Wednesday that rumors indicate Trump is planning to allow Chinese cars to be sold in the United States as part of a larger deal he is working on, which would be a strategic mistake.
Trump dismissed Slotkin’s statement as “completely fake news” and said he has always kept Chinese cars out of the U.S. market.

Under a regulation implemented by the Biden administration in early 2025, the United States effectively bans all Chinese manufacturers from selling or producing passenger cars domestically. Washington currently levies tariffs of over 100% on Chinese electric vehicles.
U.S. automakers have publicly urged Trump not to agree to let Chinese car manufacturers enter the U.S. market.

The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, representing major manufacturers such as GM, Ford, Toyota, Volkswagen, Hyundai, Honda and Stellantis, urged Congress to pass a bill by the end of December that permanently bans Chinese cars from entering the United States.
Alliance CEO John Bozzella, in a letter to congressional leaders, accused Chinese car makers of using subsidies to dump globally connected software‑ and hardware‑equipped vehicles worldwide.

items.title: 創辦49年來罕見！甲骨文艾里森擬拋售75億美元股票 AI擴建背負龐大債務引關注
items.title_en: Rare Since Its Founding 49 Years Ago! Oracle Founder Ellison Plans to Sell $7.5 Billion of Stock, AI Expansion Burdened by Massive Debt Draws Attention
paras: 最新監管資料顯示，甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)創辦人艾里森(Larry Ellison)已啟動一項股票交易計畫，未來最多可出售5000萬股持股，以目前股價計算，價值約75億美元，如此大手筆減持並不尋常。
根據周五(11日)公布的監管文件，艾里森於6月22日採納這項交易計畫，預計於10月24日結束。
對於艾里森而言，這是一項不尋常的舉動。自1977年創辦甲骨文以來，他一直持有公司極高比例的股份。根據FactSet資料，艾里森目前手握甲骨文逾40%股權，即使他出售交易計畫涵蓋的所有股票，仍將持有約11億股。
FactSet資料顯示，自本世紀初以來，艾里森從未在單次交易中出售超過2.5萬股甲骨文股票。
甲骨文押注AI基礎建設 卻背負龐大債務
現年82歲的艾里森協助甲骨文從一家老牌軟體公司，轉型為人工智慧(AI)基礎建設領域的重要業者。甲骨文本周四公布的上季財報優於市場預期，雲端基礎建設營收年增121%，成為主要成長動能。
不過，甲骨文為推動這項轉型也承擔了大量債務，引發投資人疑慮，導致甲骨文股價今年以來下跌約20%。
身為全球第七大富豪的艾里森，也曾為兒子大衛·艾里森旗下製片公司日舞(Skydance)在2025年與派拉蒙(Paramount)合併的交易中出資。
paras_en: The latest regulatory filings show that Larry Ellison, founder of Oracle (ORCL-US), has launched a stock transaction plan that could sell up to 50 million shares, worth about $7.5 billion at current prices – an unusually large divestiture.
According to regulatory documents released on Friday the 11th, Ellison adopted the transaction plan on June 22 and expects it to conclude on October 24.

For Ellison, this is an atypical move. Since founding Oracle in 1977, he has held a very high proportion of the company’s shares. FactSet data shows Ellison currently controls over 40% of Oracle, and even if he sells all the shares covered by the plan, he will still own roughly 1.1 billion shares.
FactSet data indicates that since the turn of the century, Ellison has never sold more than 25,000 Oracle shares in a single transaction.
Oracle Bets on AI Infrastructure Yet Carries Massive Debt

The 82‑year‑old Ellison has helped transform Oracle from a legacy software firm into a key player in artificial‑intelligence infrastructure. Oracle’s quarterly results released this Thursday beat market expectations, with cloud infrastructure revenue up 121% year‑over‑year, becoming the main growth driver.
However, Oracle’s push for this transformation has also taken on a large amount of debt, raising investor concerns and causing Oracle’s stock to fall about 20% so far this year.
As the world’s seventh‑richest person, Ellison also funded his son David Ellison’s production company Skydance in its 2025 merger deal with Paramount.

items.title: Dyson AI牙刷CameraJet遭下架！上市不到兩週傳瑕疵  網友爆過熱、進水
items.title_en: Dyson AI Toothbrush CameraJet Pulled from Shelves! Less Than Two Weeks After Launch Reported Flaws, Users Claim Overheating and Water Ingress
paras: 戴森（Dyson） 9月初推出首款搭載人工智慧（AI）與相機的電動牙刷CameraJet，主打透過鏡頭辨識牙齒間隙，再以精準水柱清潔難以觸及的區域。不過，產品上市後陸續傳出品質問題，目前已在部分市場下架或顯示缺貨。
根據《Cybernews》報導，Dyson CameraJet牙刷是一款搭載AI技術的裝置，內建相機，可協助使用者清潔難以觸及的區域，進而改善口腔護理。
不過，在多名使用者提出抱怨後，這款售價499.99美元的牙刷已無法在Dyson美國官網購買。
目前，Dyson美國官網已出現「通知我」按鈕，使用者可在產品恢復供貨時收到通知。
同時，根據《Numerama》報導，自9月11日起，Dyson牙刷也已無法在Dyson法國版官網及其零售門市購買。英國官網則將該產品標示為「缺貨」。
一名法國產品設計師在X上分享了更多有關這款產品突然遭召回的消息。他表示：「我的消息來源剛告訴我，Dyson的牙刷似乎正在醞釀一場公關災難。顯然，Dyson目前的情況不太樂觀。召回並停售。」
他同時附上一封Dyson寄給使用者的電子郵件截圖，內容通知使用者，其裝置已被退回Dyson的倉庫。
這篇貼文也促使其他使用者分享自身經驗。其中，一名在零售業工作的使用者透露，牙刷已暫停銷售，原因是出現「過熱問題，以及與更換刷頭相關的缺陷」。
隨後，多名使用者分享使用這款裝置時遇到的問題。有些人注意到牙刷部分零件已經出現氧化，另一些人則遇到充電問題。
X上一名使用者補充表示：「過熱問題導致受影響的牙刷在首次使用後就故障。這個問題會在下一批產品中修正。但沒錯，這確實造成了非常嚴重的負面聲勢。」
Reddit上也出現類似問題的回報，有數名使用者發現電池槽內有水。一名網友寫道：「目前絕對不值得買，」並暗示自己會等到下一款產品推出。
另一名網友則表示：「我稍早想買一支，但被告知英國目前暫時已因為某項問題將產品下架。」這也暗示相關問題可能已影響全球各地的Dyson CameraJet使用者。
paras_en: In early September, Dyson launched its first electric toothbrush, the CameraJet, which incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) and a camera. It is marketed as using the lens to identify gaps between teeth and then delivering precise water jets to clean hard‑to‑reach areas. However, after the product hit the market, quality issues began to surface, and it has now been withdrawn from some markets or shown as out of stock.
According to Cybernews, the Dyson CameraJet toothbrush is an AI‑enabled device with a built‑in camera that helps users clean hard‑to‑reach spots, thereby improving oral care.
After multiple users complained, the $499.99 toothbrush is no longer purchasable on Dyson’s U.S. website.
The Dyson U.S. site now displays a “Notify Me” button, allowing customers to receive an alert when the product is back in stock.
Similarly, Numerama reported that as of September 11 the toothbrush was unavailable on Dyson’s French website and in its French retail stores, while the UK site lists the item as “out of stock.”

A French product designer shared on X more details about the sudden recall, saying, “My source just told me Dyson’s toothbrush seems to be brewing a PR disaster. Clearly, Dyson’s situation isn’t looking good. Recall and stop sales.”
He also posted a screenshot of an email Dyson sent to users, informing them that their devices had been returned to Dyson’s warehouse.

The post prompted other users to share their experiences. One retail‑industry employee disclosed that sales were halted because of an “overheating issue and a defect related to brush‑head replacement.”
Subsequently, several users reported problems they encountered with the device. Some noticed oxidation on certain parts, while others experienced charging failures.

A user on X added, “The overheating issue caused the affected toothbrushes to fail after the first use. This will be fixed in the next batch. But yes, it has generated a very serious negative backlash.”

Similar reports appeared on Reddit, where multiple users found water inside the battery compartment. One commenter wrote, “It’s absolutely not worth buying right now,” and hinted they would wait for the next model.
Another user said, “I tried to buy one earlier, but was told the UK has temporarily pulled the product because of an issue,” suggesting the problem may have affected Dyson CameraJet users worldwide.

items.title: 若升息美股反有望迎「下一波多頭」行情？Fed升息機率飆至87%
items.title_en: If Rate Hikes Could Spark the Next Bull Market for U.S. Stocks? Fed Hike Odds Jump to 87%
paras: 市場對美國聯準會（Fed）升息的預期快速升溫，壓抑本週美股表現，標普500指數下跌約0.7%，那斯達克綜合指數回落0.5%，道瓊工業指數則下挫1.4%。不過，部分市場人士認為，如果升息能有效穩定債市、遏制通膨，這次升息反而可能成為股市下一階段行情的催化劑。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預期升息機率已從一週前的59%大幅升至週五（11日）的87%。
本週公布的通膨數據顯示，物價漲幅仍高於聯準會2%的目標，加上油價本週再漲9%，通膨壓力短期內似乎仍難以緩解。
此外，美國前一週公布的8月就業報告表現強勁，也進一步增加市場對升息的預期。
不過，即使聯準會最終升息25個基點，市場實際受到的衝擊可能沒有想像中大，原因在於利率本身已經出現明顯上行。
10年期美國公債殖利率已從6月底的4.4%大幅升至接近5%，2年期殖利率也出現幅度相近的升幅。30年期美債殖利率週四（10日）收在5.36%，創下2004年6月以來最高水準。
殖利率快速攀升自然對股市構成壓力。儘管分析師已連續21週上調企業獲利預期，但美股自6月以來整體幾乎原地踏步。
然而，市場至今並未出現災難性崩跌。
美銀全球股票衍生品研究主管Benjamin Bowler指出，市場確實擔心利率變化可能干擾股市，但科技股熱潮形成的動能相當強勁，宏觀經濟風險必須達到相當高的程度，才足以對市場構成威脅。
Bowler並指出，類似情況也曾出現在1990年代末期。當時30年期美債殖利率上升2個百分點，聯準會升息幅度超過1個百分點，但那斯達克指數仍持續上演多頭行情。
他預期，即使股市出現修正，買盤仍可能迅速回流，讓市場重新走強，網路泡沫時期及較近期的市場表現都曾出現類似情況。
在這樣的背景下，若美股再度走低，投資人可能反而將回檔視為進場機會，短期利率稍微走高未必足以改變這項趨勢。
投資公司Madison固定收益主管Mike Sanders認為，關鍵在於升息能否穩定長天期債券殖利率。
Sanders表示，在目前的環境下，升息可能向市場傳遞明確訊號，顯示聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）確實致力於壓制通膨。反過來說，如果華許在此前承諾要讓高通膨「成為過去」後，卻選擇避開升息，可能讓市場認為聯準會只是口頭表態。
這種情況可能損害聯準會的政策公信力，也可能加深市場對未來多年通膨維持高檔的擔憂。
從這個角度來看，一次市場已大致消化、且被認為有必要的升息，對長天期債券與股票反而可能成為相對正面的事件。
畢竟，債券投資人不希望看到高通膨，股市投資人同樣不樂見物價持續上升，尤其當通膨已對消費者信心造成明顯壓力。
這或許也能解釋，為何週五通膨數據略高於市場預期後，標普500指數反而上漲近1%，終結連續4個交易日的跌勢。
市場當時的解讀是，若聯準會因通膨壓力被迫升息，反而有助於維持政策公信力。
從傳統角度來看，股市通常不歡迎升息，因為更高利率可能抑制經濟活動，也會提高債券相較股票的吸引力。
但目前的市場環境呈現出一項矛盾現象：投資人關注的可能不只是利率究竟上升多少，而是政策是否足夠明確、能否帶來穩定性。
本週稍早，隨著市場對升息的預期升溫，美股確實承受壓力；但如果升息已被市場充分反映，同時又被視為控制通膨所需的政策行動，那麼升息本身反而可能降低市場對通膨失控的疑慮。
一旦這項不確定性下降，市場注意力就可能重新回到AI建設熱潮，以及由此帶動的企業獲利成長。
paras_en: The market’s expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike have heated up quickly, weighing on this week’s U.S. equities performance: the S&P 500 fell about 0.7%, the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.4%. However, some market participants believe that if a hike can effectively stabilize the bond market and curb inflation, the move could actually become a catalyst for the next phase of the equity rally.
According to Barron’s, the CME FedWatch tool shows the market’s probability of a rate hike has surged from 59% a week ago to 87% on Friday (the 11th).
Inflation data released this week showed price gains remain above the Fed’s 2% target, and with oil prices up another 9% this week, inflationary pressure appears unlikely to ease in the short term.
In addition, a strong August jobs report released by the United States last week further heightened expectations of a rate hike.
Even if the Fed ultimately raises rates by 25 basis points, the actual market impact may be smaller than imagined because rates have already risen sharply.

The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has jumped from 4.4% at the end of June to near 5%, and the 2‑year yield has risen by a similar margin. The 30‑year yield closed at 5.36% on Thursday (the 10th), the highest level since June 2004.
Rapidly climbing yields naturally put pressure on equities. Although analysts have upgraded corporate earnings forecasts for 21 consecutive weeks, the overall U.S. market has barely moved since June.
Nevertheless, the market has not experienced a catastrophic crash so far.

Benjamin Bowler, head of global equity derivatives research at Bank of America, said the market is indeed worried that rate changes could disrupt equities, but the momentum behind the tech‑stock rally is strong, and macro‑economic risks would have to be quite severe to threaten the market.

Bowler noted a similar situation occurred in the late 1990s. Back then, the 30‑year Treasury yield rose two percentage points and the Fed’s hikes exceeded one percentage point, yet the Nasdaq continued its bull run.
He expects that even if a correction occurs, buying pressure could quickly return, reviving market strength—a pattern seen during the dot‑com bubble and more recent periods.
In this context, if U.S. stocks dip again, investors may actually view the pull‑back as a buying opportunity; a modest rise in short‑term rates may not be enough to alter that trend.
Mike Sanders, head of fixed income at Madison Investment, believes the key is whether the hike can stabilize long‑term bond yields.

Sanders said that in the current environment, a hike could send a clear signal that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is truly committed to taming inflation. Conversely, if Warsh, after pledging to make high inflation “a thing of the past,” avoids a hike, the market might view the Fed as merely paying lip service.
Such a scenario could damage the Fed’s policy credibility and deepen concerns that inflation will stay elevated for years to come.
From that perspective, a rate hike that the market has largely priced in and deems necessary could actually be a relatively positive event for long‑term bonds and equities.
After all, bond investors don’t want high inflation, and equity investors likewise dislike rising prices, especially when inflation is already putting clear pressure on consumer confidence.
That may also explain why, after Friday’s inflation numbers came in slightly above expectations, the S&P 500 rose nearly 1%, ending a four‑day losing streak.
The market’s reading at the time was that if the Fed is forced to hike due to inflation pressure, it could help preserve policy credibility.
Traditionally, equities dislike rate hikes because higher rates can dampen economic activity and make bonds more attractive relative to stocks.
But the current market environment shows a paradox: investors may care less about how much rates rise and more about whether policy is clear enough and can deliver stability.

Earlier this week, as expectations of a hike warmed, U.S. stocks indeed felt pressure; however, if the hike is already fully priced in and seen as a necessary step to control inflation, the hike itself could actually reduce worries about runaway inflation.
Once that uncertainty fades, market focus may shift back to the AI construction boom and the earnings growth it drives.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro系列在中國正式預售 開售數分鐘首批貨源賣光
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Series Begins Pre‑sale in China, First Stock Sells Out Within Minutes
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone 18 Pro系列12日（周六）晚8點正式啟動預售，開售僅數分鐘，蘋果中國官網、淘寶、京東等主流電商平台多個熱門型號首批貨源相繼售罄。
冰川藍色iPhone 18 Pro及 iPhone 18 Pro Max的256GB、512GB、1TB在蘋果官網預計發貨時間均已推遲至9月30日。
據《科創板日報》報導，今天下午，深圳一家蘋果授權店iPhone 18 Pro系列的登記預訂量已有五六十單，預訂無需支付定金，門市採取「到貨後按登記順序通知」 方式發售。
店員說，在顏色偏好方面，登記預訂的消費者中，選擇藍色與酒紅色兩款配色的人數最多。
值得一提的是，首批貨源快速消化，部分急於第一時間入手新機的消費者，開始轉向第三方渠道求購，iPhone 18 Pro 系列的市場成交價格也隨之出現波動。
在得物App上，iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB勃艮第酒紅色成交均價為人民幣（下同）12,799元，大漲1,800元，漲幅16.4%；同為256GB的銀色版本成交均價達到13,999元，漲了3,000元，漲幅27.3%。
iPhone 18 Pro價格上漲幅度相對較小。256GB勃艮第酒紅色和銀色版本成交均價均為10,999元，漲1000元，漲幅10.0%；冰川藍色256GB成交均價為11,499元，漲1,500元，漲幅15.0%。1TB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交均價為16,699元，漲1,200元，漲幅7.7%。
高容量版本的市場價格同樣出現上漲。iPhone 18 Pro Max冰川藍色1TB成交均價為18,299元，漲1,800元，漲幅10.9%；黑色2TB成交均價達到24,700元，漲3,201元，漲幅14.9%。
在得物App首輪預售成交數量中，iPhone 18 Pro Max和iPhone 18 Pro的256GB勃艮第酒紅色版本成交數量最多，是目前成交熱度最高的機型。
手機渠道商家表示，今年首批市場價格是否會持續處於高檔，需要觀察後續供給。
該商家說，從產品變化來看，iPhone 18 Pro系列此次升級更多集中在晶片、通訊、續航散熱、影像等內部能力，外觀整體變化相對有限，消費者對部分升級的直觀感知可能並不強。
與此同時，新機價格上漲也進一步提高渠道商的備貨成本和囤貨風險，部分商家對首批新機的收貨相對謹慎。
該商家提到：「蘋果的產能爬升速度比較快，發售後三到四周供給會明顯增加。剛開始貨少，現貨價格會高一點，隨著貨源陸續進入市場，價格一般會在10月中下旬進入相對穩定階段。」
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched the pre‑sale of the iPhone 18 Pro series at 8 p.m. on Saturday, the 12th. Within minutes the first batches of several popular models on Apple’s China website, Taobao, JD.com and other major e‑commerce platforms sold out.
The Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in 256 GB, 512 GB and 1 TB configurations have had their estimated shipping dates on Apple’s website pushed back to September 30.

According to the Science‑Innovation Board Daily, an Apple‑authorized store in Shenzhen reported this afternoon that it had already received fifty‑to‑sixty registration orders for the iPhone 18 Pro series. No deposit is required for registration, and the store will notify customers in registration order once the devices arrive.
The sales staff said that among the registered customers, the blue and burgundy color options were the most popular.

It is worth noting that the rapid sell‑through of the first stock prompted some eager buyers to turn to third‑party channels, causing market transaction prices for the iPhone 18 Pro series to fluctuate.
On the Dewu app, the average transaction price for the 256 GB iPhone 18 Pro Max in Burgundy rose to ¥12,799, up ¥1,800 or 16.4%. The 256 GB silver version averaged ¥13,999, up ¥3,000 or 27.3%.

The iPhone 18 Pro saw smaller price increases. Both the 256 GB Burgundy and silver versions averaged ¥10,999, up ¥1,000 (10.0%). The 256 GB Glacier‑blue averaged ¥11,499, up ¥1,500 (15.0%). The 1 TB Burgundy version averaged ¥16,699, up ¥1,200 (7.7%).
High‑capacity models also rose in price. The 1 TB Glacier‑blue iPhone 18 Pro Max averaged ¥18,299, up ¥1,800 (10.9%). The 2 TB black version averaged ¥24,700, up ¥3,201 (14.9%).

In the first round of pre‑sale transactions on Dewu, the 256 GB Burgundy versions of both iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro recorded the highest sales volumes, making them the hottest models so far.
Channel merchants said it remains to be seen whether the initial market prices will stay high this year, depending on subsequent supply.

The merchant noted that the iPhone 18 Pro series upgrades focus more on internal capabilities such as the chip, communications, battery life, thermal management and imaging, with relatively limited exterior changes, so consumers may not perceive the upgrades strongly.
At the same time, the price hikes increase merchants’ inventory costs and stocking risks, leading some to be cautious about receiving the first batch of new phones.

The merchant added: “Apple’s production ramp‑up is relatively fast; supply will increase noticeably three to four weeks after launch. Early on, limited stock drives higher spot prices, but as inventory flows into the market, prices should stabilize around mid‑to‑late October.”

items.title: 南韓半導體出口首破400兆韓元！AI需求推升三星、SK海力士業績
items.title_en: South Korea's Semiconductor Exports Break 400 Trillion Won for the First Time, AI Demand Boosts Samsung and SK Hynix Earnings
paras: 南韓半導體出口今年以來首度突破400兆韓元大關，人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）等產品需求，三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 業績同步走強，半導體在南韓出口結構中的占比也進一步攀升。
南韓關稅廳週五（11日）公布數據顯示，9月前10天南韓半導體出口額達164.8億美元，年增270.1%，創歷年同期新高。
同期間，南韓整體出口額為349.7億美元，半導體占比達47.1%，較去年同期大增23.9個百分點。
今年以來截至9月前10天，南韓半導體累計出口額已達2976.8億美元，折合約400.5兆韓元，首度突破400兆韓元。
南韓半導體出口規模也已遠超過過去年度紀錄。2025年全年出口額為1734億美元，2024年則為1419億美元；今年9月初，2025年的年度紀錄便已遭大幅超越。
若目前出口成長趨勢延續，南韓半導體出口有望連續第3年創下年度新高。

半導體成南韓突破1兆美元出口關鍵

半導體產業景氣升溫，也推動南韓朝年度出口額突破1兆美元的目標邁進。
南韓關稅廳數據顯示，截至9月10日，南韓今年累計出口額已達7285.6億美元，超越2025年全年7093億美元的出口規模。
目前全球僅美國、中國與德國曾實現年度出口額突破1兆美元，南韓若要成為第4個達成這項規模的國家，半導體出口能否維持強勁成長，將成為重要因素。
隨著全球AI基礎建設投資預計在下半年持續成長，半導體需求能否延續目前的強勢表現，也將直接影響南韓全年出口表現。

三星、SK海力士受惠AI記憶體需求

三星電子與SK海力士是此次南韓半導體出口成長的主要支柱，兩家公司均受惠於AI應用帶動的HBM需求，以及記憶體晶片價格上漲。
三星電子半導體事業第1季營收達81.7兆韓元，營業利益為53.7兆韓元；第2季營收進一步升至127.5兆韓元，營業利益達89.2兆韓元。
累計上半年，三星電子半導體事業營收達209.2兆韓元，營業利益為142.9兆韓元。
SK海力士第1季營收為52.5763兆韓元，營業利益37.6103兆韓元；第2季營收增至79.3187兆韓元，營業利益達60.5426兆韓元。
上半年SK海力士累計營收為131.895兆韓元，營業利益98.1529兆韓元，營業利益率達76.3%。
KB證券表示，隨著記憶體晶片價格上漲及HBM供應增加，三星電子已進入業績快速成長階段。
KB證券研究主管Kim Dong-won指出，在現行3年股東回報計畫下，三星電子預計第3季進行30兆韓元現金股利，年內也可能透過股票買回及註銷、現金股利等方式進一步提高股東回報，目前剩餘可用資金約80兆韓元。
他表示，三星電子即將公布的新一輪3年股東回報政策，可能進一步提高股利比例，使股東回報率超過目前自由現金流50%的水準。

半導體熱潮延燒　韓股資金聚焦龍頭

三星電子與SK海力士業績強勁，也帶動南韓投資人對半導體股的關注。
金融數據業者FnGuide統計，9月1日至7日，三星電子以1672次搜尋次數成為南韓投資人搜尋最多的股票，SK海力士則以1342次排名第2。排名第3的現代汽車搜尋次數為679次，與兩大半導體企業存在明顯差距。
半導體市場的樂觀情緒也延伸至海外市場。美國投行Piper Sandler給予AMD「增持」評級，並將目標價設定為600美元。
此外，南韓生技醫藥產業也受到市場關注。KOSDAQ市值最大的企業Alteogen與瑞士製藥商諾華簽署獨家授權協議，將ALT-B4平台授權予諾華使用。
新韓證券分析師Um Min-yong表示，這是諾華首次將基因療法轉換為皮下注射劑型的相關合作，技術授權規模也超出市場預期，業務範圍進一步從腫瘤藥物拓展至新的治療模式。隨後，他將Alteogen目標價上調至54萬韓元。
整體而言，AI需求正成為推動南韓出口成長的重要力量。隨著HBM等高附加價值半導體產品需求增加，半導體占南韓出口的比重持續攀升，其對南韓經濟與資本市場的影響也進一步擴大。
paras_en: South Korea's semiconductor exports have surpassed the 400‑trillion‑won mark for the first time this year, as AI infrastructure demand continues to drive demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other products, lifting the performance of Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS); the share of semiconductors in South Korea's export basket also rose further.

Data released by South Korea's customs office on Friday (the 11th) showed that in the first ten days of September, South Korean semiconductor exports amounted to $16.48 billion, up 270.1% year‑on‑year, a record high for the same period in history.
During the same period, total South Korean exports were $34.97 billion, with semiconductors accounting for 47.1% of the total – an increase of 23.9 percentage points from a year earlier.

Since the start of the year up to the first ten days of September, cumulative South Korean semiconductor exports have reached $297.68 billion, roughly 400.5 trillion won, breaking the 400‑trillion‑won barrier for the first time.

The scale of South Korean semiconductor exports now far exceeds past annual records. The full‑year export figure for 2025 was $173.4 billion, and for 2024 it was $141.9 billion; by early September this year the 2025 record had already been vastly surpassed.
If the current export growth trend continues, South Korean semiconductor exports are likely to set a new annual high for the third consecutive year.
Semiconductors are the key to South Korea breaking the $1 trillion export milestone, as the industry’s up‑turn also pushes the country toward its goal of exceeding $1 trillion in annual exports.
Customs data show that as of September 10, South Korea’s cumulative exports for the year have reached $728.56 billion, overtaking the full‑year export volume of 2025, which was $709.3 billion.

To date only the United States, China and Germany have achieved annual export totals above $1 trillion; if South Korea becomes the fourth country to do so, the ability of semiconductor exports to maintain strong growth will be a decisive factor.

With global AI infrastructure investment expected to keep rising in the second half of the year, whether semiconductor demand can sustain its current momentum will directly affect South Korea’s overall export performance.
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the main pillars behind the recent surge in South Korean semiconductor exports, both benefiting from AI‑driven HBM demand and higher memory‑chip prices.

Samsung’s semiconductor division posted first‑quarter revenue of 81.7 trillion won and operating profit of 53.7 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue rose further to 127.5 trillion won with operating profit of 89.2 trillion won.
For the first half of the year, Samsung’s semiconductor business generated revenue of 209.2 trillion won and operating profit of 142.9 trillion won.

SK Hynix reported first‑quarter revenue of 52.5763 trillion won and operating profit of 37.6103 trillion won; second‑quarter revenue increased to 79.3187 trillion won with operating profit of 60.5426 trillion won.
For the first half, SK Hynix’s cumulative revenue was 131.895 trillion won, operating profit 98.1529 trillion won, yielding an operating margin of 76.3%.
KB Securities said that with memory‑chip prices rising and HBM supply expanding, Samsung has entered a phase of rapid earnings growth.

KB Securities research head Kim Dong‑won noted that under the current three‑year shareholder‑return plan, Samsung plans a 30‑trillion‑won cash dividend in Q3 and may further boost shareholder returns later this year through share buybacks, cancellations and additional cash dividends, with roughly 80 trillion won of usable funds remaining.
He added that Samsung’s upcoming new three‑year shareholder‑return policy could raise the dividend payout ratio, pushing the shareholder‑return rate above the current free‑cash‑flow level of 50%.
The semiconductor boom is spilling over to the equity market, with strong results from Samsung and SK Hynix drawing South Korean investors’ attention to semiconductor stocks.

FnGuide data show that from September 1‑7, Samsung was searched 1,672 times, the most‑searched stock among South Korean investors, while SK Hynix ranked second with 1,342 searches; the third‑most‑searched stock, Hyundai Motor, recorded 679 searches, a clear gap from the two semiconductor giants.
Optimism in the semiconductor market is also extending overseas. U.S. investment bank Piper Sandler upgraded AMD to an “overweight” rating and set a target price of $600.

In addition, South Korea’s biotech sector is attracting interest. Alteogen, the largest KOSDAQ‑listed company by market cap, signed an exclusive licensing agreement with Swiss pharma giant Novartis to grant Novartis use of its ALT‑B4 platform.

Um Min‑yong, an analyst at Shinhan Securities, said this is Novartis’s first collaboration to convert a gene‑therapy product into a subcutaneous injection, with the licensing scope exceeding market expectations and expanding the business from oncology drugs to new therapeutic modalities; he subsequently raised Alteogen’s target price to 540,000 won.

Overall, AI demand is becoming a major driver of South Korea’s export growth. As demand for high‑value‑added semiconductor products such as HBM rises, the share of semiconductors in South Korean exports continues to climb, amplifying its impact on the country’s economy and capital markets.

items.title: 蘋果CEO特努斯談iPhone Duo：「軟硬體一體」才是摺疊螢幕核心
items.title_en: Apple CEO Ternus on iPhone Duo: "Hardware‑Software Integration" Is the Core of Foldable Screens
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊 iPhone 正式亮相後，執行長特納斯（John Ternus）與行銷資深副總裁Greg Joswiak接受媒體聯訪，談及這款新品的研發理念、設計方向、定價策略，以及蘋果如何在產品開發過程中維持機密。
根據《Tom's Guide》報導，特納斯表示，蘋果始終將產品品質、耐用度與設計標準視為推出新品的重要門檻，只有整體產品構想符合公司既定要求，才會正式推向市場。
他指出，iPhone Duo 專案讓團隊有機會從零開始探索新的產品形式，重新思考硬體、軟體及整體產品形態，並藉由軟硬體整合打造最終產品。
Joswiak表示，蘋果曾研究市場上現有的摺疊手機，認為部分產品在設計上存在較強的「拼接感」，因此團隊希望透過不同的螢幕比例與軟體體驗，讓 iPhone Duo 建立自身特色。
iPhone Duo 採用 1:1.4 的螢幕比例，同時重新設計軟體使用體驗，以配合摺疊形態。
針對摺疊螢幕常見的手感問題，蘋果在內螢幕表層採用聚合物材質，並自行開發奈米紋理表面工藝，改善螢幕表面的平整度與觸控手感，同時提升耐用性。
特納斯指出，部分市售摺疊裝置的螢幕存在觸感偏向塑膠、表面褶皺起伏等問題，而蘋果開發的奈米紋理工藝，就是希望針對這些問題進行改善。
摺疊 iPhone 的相關消息早已在產品正式發表前曝光，部分產品規格也提前流出。對此，兩名蘋果高層也談到 iPhone Duo 在研發期間採取的保密措施。
特納斯與Joswiak表示，為保護核心技術，iPhone Duo 專案使用與產品無直接關聯的內部代號，並強化整個開發流程的保密管理。
雖然螢幕比例等資訊提前曝光，但可摺疊奈米紋理顯示螢幕這項核心技術細節，仍成功維持到產品正式發表，成為此次研發保密工作的成果之一。
iPhone Duo 起跳價為1999美元，明顯高於一般智慧手機。對於產品定價，特納斯坦言價格確實較高，但蘋果團隊認為，其整體產品體驗具備相應價值。
Joswiak則解釋，iPhone Duo 的命名本身就反映產品定位，意在代表這款裝置整合兩類裝置的使用能力。
另一方面，剛接任蘋果執行長約一週的特納斯也談到履新後的感受。他表示，能夠接下蘋果發展的接力棒是一項莫大榮幸，自己半生職涯都在蘋果度過，對公司及研發團隊抱有深厚感情，也期待帶領團隊持續推動產品創新。
工程師出身的特納斯在產品溝通上的表現，也被形容較前任管理者更為外放。他回憶，在看到 iPhone Duo 的螢幕原型機時，就確認這是團隊希望打造的產品方向。
paras_en: After the official unveiling of Apple’s (AAPL-US) first foldable iPhone, CEO John Ternus and senior vice president of marketing Greg Joswiak fielded joint media questions, discussing the product’s development philosophy, design direction, pricing strategy, and how Apple maintains secrecy throughout the development process.

According to Tom’s Guide, Ternus said Apple always treats product quality, durability and design standards as critical thresholds for launching new items; only when the overall concept meets the company’s established criteria does it move to market.

He noted that the iPhone Duo project gave the team a chance to start from scratch and explore a new product form, re‑thinking hardware, software and the overall product shape, and to create the final device through tight hardware‑software integration.

Joswiak said Apple studied existing foldable phones on the market and found many of them suffered from a pronounced “joint” feel in their design, so the team aimed to give the iPhone Duo its own identity by using different screen ratios and software experiences.
The iPhone Duo uses a 1:1.4 screen ratio and features a redesigned software experience to suit its folding form factor.

To address common tactile issues with foldable displays, Apple applied a polymer coating to the inner screen surface and developed its own nano‑texture surface process, improving flatness, touch feel and durability.
Ternus pointed out that some commercial foldable devices have screens that feel plasticky and show surface creases, and Apple’s nano‑texture process was created specifically to remedy those problems.

News about the foldable iPhone had leaked before the official launch, with some specifications surfacing early; the two Apple executives also discussed the confidentiality measures taken during iPhone Duo’s development.

Ternus and Joswiak said that, to protect core technology, the iPhone Duo project used an internal code name unrelated to the product and tightened secrecy controls throughout the development workflow.

Although details such as the screen ratio were leaked early, the core technology of a foldable nano‑texture display remained concealed until the official announcement, marking a success of the secrecy effort.
The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, clearly higher than typical smartphones. On pricing, Ternus admitted the cost is indeed steep, but the Apple team believes the overall experience justifies the price.
Joswiak explained that the name iPhone Duo itself reflects the product’s positioning, intended to signify the device’s ability to combine the functions of two device categories.

Meanwhile, Ternus, who took over as Apple’s CEO about a week ago, spoke about his feelings after assuming the role, saying it is a great honor to inherit Apple’s development baton, that he has spent half his career at Apple, feels deep affection for the company and its R&D teams, and looks forward to leading continued product innovation.

Ternus, an engineer by training, is described as more outgoing in product communication than his predecessor; he recalled that when he saw the iPhone Duo screen prototype, he immediately confirmed it was the direction the team wanted to pursue.

items.title: OpenAI開放Agents API！Codex代理框架全面向開發者開放
paras: OpenAI正將支撐旗下程式設計代理Codex的底層技術進一步對外開放，將過去累積於內部產品與企業服務的人工智慧（AI）代理開發經驗，轉化為開發者可直接使用的API。
OpenAI近日宣布，Agents API正式進入公開測試階段，現在所有開發者均可使用。過去這套代理框架及相關基礎設施主要應用於Codex與企業版ChatGPT，如今則以API形式開放，開發者不需額外支付訂閱費，只須按照實際使用的token及工具呼叫量付費。
隨著Codex及ChatGPT for Work過去一年觸及全球數百萬名使用者，OpenAI在實際應用中發現，讓AI代理長時間執行複雜任務，單靠模型本身並不足夠。
代理還需要能夠管理上下文、使用工具、協調其他代理，以及在能讀寫檔案、執行程式碼並保存中間結果的環境中持續運作。
早期客戶的使用結果也顯示，這套架構已帶來一定效益。SafetyKit將案件審核流程移轉至Agents API後，單一案件的處理成本降低60%；Hypha透過將代理執行框架與沙箱環境分離，使代理回應失敗率降低86%；科技公司Cirridae的評估分數則由0.71提升至0.85，同時延遲降低4倍。

單次API呼叫即可建立長時間運作代理

Agents API的主要目的，是降低企業及開發者打造長時間運作AI代理所需的工程成本。
過去每當新的AI模型推出，開發者往往需要重新調整甚至重建自己的代理執行框架，才能使用模型新增的能力。
OpenAI希望透過版本化的Agents API，讓模型更新能直接對應相應的能力，而不必由開發者自行重新打造底層架構。
根據OpenAI的設計，開發者只要在API呼叫中指定任務、模型、工具及執行環境，即可建立可用於生產環境的代理，無須自行處理上下文管理及子代理協調等底層工作。
Agents API目前具備3項主要能力。
首先是自動壓縮上下文。當對話內容接近模型上下文容量上限時，系統會自動壓縮較早期的資訊，使代理能夠持續執行數小時甚至數天。
其次是工具搜尋與平行呼叫。系統可依照任務需求載入相關工具定義，降低token使用量，同時允許多項工具呼叫平行執行。
第三則是多代理協作。主要代理可以將複雜工作拆解後交給多個子代理平行處理，每個子代理各自維持上下文，再由主要代理整合最終結果。
物流科技公司Nash表示，目前透過Agents API部署數千個長時間運作的AI代理，用於管理全球數億次配送任務，單次代理執行時間可持續數小時甚至數天。

自託管沙箱與多家雲端業者提供部署選項

除了代理框架本身，Agents API也提供不同的執行環境選擇。
OpenAI提供自託管沙箱，並與Codex及ChatGPT採用相同的沙箱基礎設施，讓代理能夠快速啟動並進行彈性擴展。
此外，OpenAI已與Blaxel、Cloudflare、Daytona、DigitalOcean、E2B、Modal、甲骨文（Oracle）、Runloop及Vercel等合作夥伴進行一級整合，提供不同的部署選項，包括私有雲、特定儲存需求，以及不同CPU、GPU與記憶體配置。
OpenAI表示，這種架構可涵蓋從新創團隊快速驗證產品，到企業級正式部署等不同需求。
建築及居家服務AI平台Long Lake表示，透過Agents API，團隊目前可在數小時內將AI代理部署至不同產業，過去則可能需要數天。

開源Codex執行框架　模型升級可直接受惠

Agents API是建立在開源Codex執行框架之上，開發者可以透過公開程式碼庫了解模型呼叫、工具協調及上下文管理等核心運作方式。
OpenAI則負責持續維護及更新這套框架。換言之，當新模型推出時，開發者可直接取得更新後的能力，而不必自行重新設計整套代理架構。
OpenAI指出，Agents API目前仍處於公開測試階段，後續將根據開發者回饋持續調整，並朝正式發布推進。
在工具支援方面，Agents API支援MCP協定、自訂函式及網頁搜尋等內建工具。定價方面，API本身不另收訂閱費，開發者則依實際token消耗及工具使用量支付費用。

items.title: 習近平抵達印度出席金磚峰會！睽違7年訪印、與莫迪3年內第3度會面
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in India for BRICS Summit! First Visit in Seven Years and Third Meeting with Modi in Three Years
paras: 中國國家主席習近平週六（12日）抵達印度新德里，出席金磚國家（BRICS）領導人峰會，並與印度總理莫迪（Narendra Modi）舉行會談。
根據《路透》報導，此次訪問是習近平7年來首次訪問印度，適逢這兩個亞洲鄰國正謹慎重建雙邊關係。
兩國關係在2020年喜馬拉雅山爭議邊境發生軍事衝突後嚴重受損，當時共有20名印度士兵及4名中國士兵死亡。
印度電視頻道畫面顯示，習近平下機後獲紅毯迎接，現場並有印度女性表演傳統舞蹈。
中國外交部發言人週五（11日）表示，習近平與莫迪預定於週六晚間舉行會談，這將是兩國領導人在3年內第3次會面。
該發言人表示，中國「願意」與印度合作，從戰略及長期角度看待雙邊關係，妥善處理分歧，並成為「好鄰居、好朋友，以及相互支持的夥伴」。
金磚國家成員包括巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國、南非、埃及、衣索比亞、印尼、伊朗及阿拉伯聯合大公國。
此次峰會是在地緣政治緊張局勢升高的背景下舉行，美以對伊朗的戰爭、俄烏戰爭，以及這些衝突對全球能源、貿易與運輸造成的干擾，均加劇了當前的地緣政治緊張情勢。
paras_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi on Saturday (the 12th) to attend the BRICS leaders’ summit and hold talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
According to Reuters, this is Xi’s first visit to India in seven years, coming as the two Asian neighbours cautiously work to rebuild bilateral ties.
Relations were severely damaged after a 2020 military clash on the Himalayan border, which left 20 Indian soldiers and four Chinese soldiers dead.
Indian TV footage showed Xi being greeted on the red carpet after disembarking, with Indian women performing a traditional dance at the venue.
China’s foreign ministry spokesperson said on Friday (the 11th) that Xi and Modi were scheduled to meet on Saturday evening, marking the third meeting between the two leaders in three years.

The spokesperson said China is “willing” to cooperate with India, viewing the bilateral relationship from a strategic and long‑term perspective, handling differences properly and becoming a “good neighbor, good friend, and mutually supportive partner.”
BRICS members include Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates.

The summit is held against a backdrop of heightened geopolitical tension, with the US‑Israel war on Iran, the Russia‑Ukraine war, and the resulting disruptions to global energy, trade and transport further intensifying the current geopolitical strain.

items.title: 胡塞武裝攻勢擴大、控制曼德海峽！一支「拖鞋軍」如何改變中東局勢？
items.title_en: Houthi Offensive Expands, Seizes Bab al-Mandeb! How a “Flip‑Flop Army” Is Changing the Middle East Landscape
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝攻勢持續擴大，戰線不僅向南逼近政府軍臨時首都亞丁，更逐步掌握紅海沿岸、曼德海峽周邊重要據點及島嶼。胡塞武裝宣稱自9月3日以來已攻占約5400平方公里土地，葉門政府則證實其已控制西部海岸，並持續向南推進；在政府軍節節撤退、沙烏地與美國未直接介入的背景下，外界認為雙方指揮體系、戰鬥意志及外援差異，正成為戰局逆轉的關鍵，而曼德海峽局勢升溫，也可能進一步牽動沙烏地石油出口及全球能源市場。
胡塞武裝發言人Yahya Saree透過該組織控制的馬西拉電視台（Al-Masirah TV）發表聲明指出，此輪攻勢針對西部沿海「沙烏地支持部隊的集結地」，並將「敵對勢力」逐出西南部塔伊茲省（Taiz）及紅海沿岸的荷台達省（Hodeidah）。
薩雷亞聲稱，交戰造成對方「數百人」傷亡或遭俘虜，與沙烏地戰機交戰期間則「擊落9架飛機」。他同時表示，目前國際海上交通仍然「安全」，但沙烏地船隻仍受到限制。

胡塞奪取曼德海峽附近據點

獲國際社會承認的葉門政府及軍方官員11日表示，胡塞武裝當天攻下曼德海峽附近、政府軍最後一個主要沿海據點祖巴卜（Zubab），並占領曼德海峽內的戰略要地丕林島（Perim Island）。
葉門政府官員指出，胡塞武裝目前已控制葉門整個西部海岸，攻勢並進一步推進至南部拉赫季省（Lahij）。
一名不具名的葉門政府官員向《新華社》表示，胡塞武裝在強化對曼德海峽及周邊重要沿海地區與島嶼的控制後，正持續向南推進。
政府軍目前已撤至拉赫季省霍爾奧邁拉（Hor Omeira）地區，距離葉門政府臨時駐地、南部沿海城市亞丁（Aden）約90公里。這名官員表示，政府軍目前正在重新集結。
當地一名安全部門官員表示，隨著戰線逐漸向亞丁方向推進，安全部隊已加強亞丁西側主要進城通道的防禦。
霍爾奧邁拉地區居民則表示，撤退中的政府軍出現低價出售武器及丟棄軍服等混亂情況。

穆哈、哈尼什群島相繼成為戰略據點

近期胡塞武裝持續加大對葉門政府軍的攻勢，並宣布對支持葉門政府的沙烏地阿拉伯實施海上禁運。
葉門政府軍與胡塞武裝10日分別證實，胡塞武裝當天攻占紅海戰略據點、港口城市穆哈（Mocha）。相關分析認為，這一重要據點易手，可能直接改變紅海航運的地緣格局。
同一天，在葉門政府海軍部隊撤離紅海戰略要地哈尼什群島（Hanish Islands）後，胡塞武裝也已在島上部署兵力。
在本輪攻勢展開前，胡塞武裝已控制葉門北部大片地區，包括首都沙那（Sanaa）及紅海重要港口荷台達，但此前尚未掌握直接俯瞰曼德海峽的沿岸地帶。

指揮體系與戰鬥意志　被視為戰局逆轉關鍵

針對裝備相對簡陋的胡塞武裝，能夠在戰場上擊敗擁有大量美製武器的葉門政府軍一事，具中國官方背景微信公眾號「牛彈琴」指出，關鍵之一在於雙方指揮體系存在明顯差異。
胡塞武裝採取集中式領導，軍令與資訊主要透過上級傳達；相較之下，葉門政府軍由不同派系組成，背後又分別受到沙烏地阿拉伯及阿聯支持，各方之間存在利益及指揮上的分歧，因此較難形成統一作戰力量。
「牛彈琴」並提到，胡塞武裝據稱禁止士兵使用手機，以控制資訊流通；政府軍則被形容為組織較為鬆散，資訊管理也相對混亂。
此外，戰鬥意志也被認為是另一項重要因素。胡塞武裝不少成員裝備及服裝簡陋，部分士兵甚至穿著拖鞋作戰，因此被外界稱為「拖鞋軍」，但相關說法認為，其成員具有強烈的反美、反以色列意識形態及戰鬥意志。
相較之下，部分政府軍士兵被指主要為領取沙烏地阿拉伯提供的薪資而參戰。，「牛彈琴」認為，武器裝備固然重要，但若缺乏戰鬥意志，再先進的武器也難以轉化為戰場優勢。
外援同樣被視為影響葉門戰局的重要因素。「牛彈琴」引用的西方說法指出，伊朗向胡塞武裝提供大量武器及情報，並協助制定作戰策略。
不過，「牛彈琴」同時認為，考慮到伊朗自身處境，其對胡塞武裝的支援仍受到限制；相較之下，沙烏地阿拉伯不僅投入資金及武器，也有美國提供支持，對葉門政府軍的資源投入明顯更多。
但問題在於，外援能否在關鍵時刻直接投入戰場，仍是另一回事。
據葉門政府軍方面說法，胡塞武裝發動猛烈攻勢期間，沙烏地阿拉伯空軍未能及時出動，因而錯過作戰機會。另有說法認為，沙烏地阿拉伯空軍出動需要取得美國批准，而美方遲遲未予批准。
「牛彈琴」並稱，沙烏地阿拉伯王儲近期曾多次與美國總統川普通話，要求美國介入，但遭到拒絕；美國僅答應提供情報等支援，主要將注意力放在伊朗，不願進一步捲入葉門戰事。

葉門人口集中西部　曼德海峽戰略價值受到關注

葉門是阿拉伯世界較為貧窮的國家之一，長年內戰造成嚴重人道及經濟困境。「牛彈琴」指出，葉門人口超過4000萬，甚至高於沙烏地阿拉伯。
目前胡塞武裝雖被形容為葉門最強大的勢力之一，但其實際控制國土比例仍僅約30%多。
葉門東部大部分為沙漠，政府軍仍掌握大片東部土地；然而，人口主要集中於西部地區，因此「牛彈琴」估計，胡塞武裝目前控制約80%的葉門人口。
在此背景下，胡塞武裝對紅海沿岸地區及丕林島的控制，更具戰略意義。丕林島位於曼德海峽中部，而曼德海峽是連接紅海及亞丁灣的重要海上通道。
「牛彈琴」認為，隨著胡塞武裝控制紅海沿岸及丕林島，曼德海峽已落入其掌控之下。若此一局勢持續，將進一步放大胡塞武裝在區域衝突中的影響力。

沙烏地石油出口面臨壓力　兩大海峽同時陷入危機

曼德海峽局勢升高，也讓沙烏地阿拉伯面臨更大壓力。
「牛彈琴」指出，荷姆茲海峽遭到封鎖後，部分沙烏地石油原本可透過東西向管道輸往紅海，再經曼德海峽出口；如今曼德海峽同樣面臨胡塞武裝威脅，使沙烏地阿拉伯石油出口受到進一步牽制。
此外，「牛彈琴」提到，9月11日沙烏地阿拉伯東西向管道遭到來自伊拉克的無人機攻擊，管道受到嚴重破壞，沙烏地阿拉伯石油出口因而全面暫停。
在能源運輸方面，「牛彈琴」將荷姆茲海峽及曼德海峽同時陷入危機，視為全球能源市場面臨的重大風險。
他在文中指出，荷姆茲海峽過去每天運輸超過2000萬桶石油，曼德海峽則涉及每日超過400萬桶石油運輸。目前，國際油價目前持續震盪，每桶價格已超過100美元。
paras_en: Yemen’s Houthi forces are widening their offensive, pushing the front line south toward the government’s provisional capital Aden and gradually taking control of key Red Sea coastal sites and islands around the Bab al‑Mandeb. The Houthis claim to have captured about 5,400 square kilometres since September 3, and the Yemeni government confirms it now controls the western coast and is advancing southward. With government troops retreating step by step and Saudi Arabia and the United States not intervening directly, observers say differences in command structures, combat morale and foreign support are becoming decisive, while the escalating situation in the Bab al‑Mandeb could further affect Saudi oil exports and global energy markets.

Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree told Al‑Masirah TV, the outlet run by the group, that this round of attacks targets the “Saudi‑backed forces’ gathering points” along the western coast and aims to drive “hostile forces” out of the southwestern Taiz province and the Red Sea‑bordering Hodeidah province.

Saree claimed the fighting caused “hundreds” of enemy casualties or captures and that during clashes with Saudi aircraft the Houthis “shot down nine planes.” He also said international maritime traffic remains “safe,” though Saudi vessels still face restrictions.

Houthi capture of positions near the Bab al‑Mandeb Internationally recognised Yemeni officials said on the 11th that the Houthis that day seized Zubab, the government’s last major coastal outpost near the Bab al‑Mandeb, and took the strategic Perim Island inside the strait.
Yemeni government officials noted the Houthis now control the entire western Yemeni coast and that the offensive is pushing further into the southern Lahij governorate.

An unnamed Yemeni government official told Xinhua that after strengthening control over the Bab al‑Mandeb and surrounding key coastal areas and islands, the Houthis are continuing their southward push.

Government forces have withdrawn to the Hor Omeira area in Lahij province, about 90 km from the government’s temporary seat in the southern coastal city of Aden. The official said the troops are re‑concentrating.
A local security official said that as the front moves toward Aden, security forces have bolstered defenses on the main western approach into the city.
Residents of the Hor Omeira area reported chaos as retreating government troops were seen selling weapons cheaply and discarding uniforms.

Mocha and the Hanish Islands become successive strategic footholds The Houthis have recently intensified attacks on Yemeni government forces and announced a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia, which backs the Yemeni government.

On the 10th, both Yemeni government forces and the Houthis confirmed that the Houthis captured the Red Sea strategic point and port city of Mocha that day. Analysts say the loss of this key site could directly reshape Red Sea shipping dynamics.
The same day, after Yemeni navy units withdrew from the strategic Hanish Islands in the Red Sea, the Houthis deployed troops onto the islands.

Before this offensive, the Houthis already controlled large swaths of northern Yemen, including the capital Sanaa and the important Red Sea port of Hodeidah, but had not yet held coastal territory that directly overlooks the Bab al‑Mandeb.

Command structure and combat morale seen as keys to a turnaround The Chinese‑state‑linked WeChat account “Niu Dan Qin” pointed out that a major factor in the Houthis’ ability to defeat the better‑armed Yemeni government forces is the stark contrast in their command systems.

The Houthis use a centralized leadership, with orders and information flowing mainly from senior commanders; by contrast, the Yemeni government army is composed of various factions backed separately by Saudi Arabia and the UAE, leading to divergent interests and command disputes that hamper unified action.

“Niu Dan Qin” also noted that the Houthis reportedly forbid soldiers from using mobile phones to control information flow, while the government forces are described as more loosely organized with chaotic information management.

Furthermore, combat morale is seen as another crucial factor. Many Houthi fighters are poorly equipped and some even fight in flip‑flops, earning them the nickname “flip‑flop army,” yet they are believed to possess a strong anti‑US, anti‑Israel ideology and high fighting spirit.

In contrast, some government soldiers are said to fight mainly for the salaries paid by Saudi Arabia. “Niu Dan Qin” argues that while weapons matter, without morale even the most advanced arms cannot translate into battlefield advantage.

Foreign aid is also viewed as a major influence on Yemen’s war. “Niu Dan Qin” cites Western sources saying Iran supplies the Houthis with large amounts of weapons and intelligence and helps devise operational strategies.

However, “Niu Dan Qin” adds that Iran’s own constraints limit its support for the Houthis; by comparison, Saudi Arabia not only provides money and weapons but also receives U.S. backing, giving the Yemeni government forces a far larger resource pool.
The question remains whether foreign assistance can be deployed directly to the front lines at decisive moments.

According to Yemeni government sources, during the Houthis’ intense offensive the Saudi air force failed to intervene in time, missing combat opportunities. Some say Saudi air operations require U.S. approval, which has been delayed.

“Niu Dan Qin” reports that the Saudi crown prince recently spoke repeatedly with U.S. President Joe Biden in Mandarin, urging U.S. involvement, but was rebuffed; the United States has only offered intelligence support and is focusing on Iran, reluctant to become further entangled in Yemen.

Yemen’s population is concentrated in the west, raising the strategic importance of the Bab al‑Mandeb Yemen is one of the poorer Arab nations, with a long‑running civil war causing severe humanitarian and economic distress. “Niu Dan Qin” notes Yemen’s population exceeds 40 million, even surpassing Saudi Arabia’s.
Although the Houthis are described as one of Yemen’s strongest forces, they actually control just over 30 % of the country’s territory.

Most of eastern Yemen is desert, and government forces still hold large eastern tracts; however, the population is mainly in the west, leading “Niu Dan Qin” to estimate the Houthis now control about 80 % of Yemen’s people.

Against this backdrop, Houthi control of the Red Sea coast and Perim Island carries heightened strategic weight. Perim lies in the middle of the Bab al‑Mandeb, a crucial maritime corridor linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.

“Niu Dan Qin” believes that with the Houthis in command of the Red Sea coast and Perim Island, the Bab al‑Mandeb is effectively under their control. If this persists, the Houthis’ influence on regional conflicts will expand further.
The Bab al‑Mandeb situation also puts Saudi oil exports under greater strain, as the kingdom faces pressure on two key straits.

“Niu Dan Qin” points out that after the Hormuz Strait was blocked, some Saudi oil that could have been piped east‑west to the Red Sea and then exported via the Bab al‑Mandeb now faces additional Houthi threats, further constraining Saudi oil shipments.
Additionally, “Niu Dan Qin” notes that on September 11 a drone attack from Iraq severely damaged Saudi’s east‑west pipeline, halting the kingdom’s oil exports entirely.
In terms of energy transport, “Niu Dan Qin” treats the simultaneous crises in the Hormuz and Bab al‑Mandeb straits as a major risk to the global energy market.

He notes that the Hormuz Strait previously moved over 20 million barrels of oil per day, while the Bab al‑Mandeb handled more than 4 million barrels daily. Currently, international oil prices remain volatile, with crude trading above $100 a barrel.

items.title: 「隨時聆聽」惹隱私爭議！Apple Watch新AI功能恐踩美竊聽法灰色地帶
items.title_en: “Always Listening” Sparks Privacy Controversy! Apple Watch’s New AI Feature May Tread a Legal Gray Area Under U.S. Eavesdropping Laws
paras: 蘋果公司(AAPL-US)近期推出的Apple Watch Series 12與Ultra 4手錶，搭載了可以「隨時聆聽」的人工智慧(AI)功能，儘管能帶來更便利的使用體驗，但也伴隨資料隱私疑慮，恐讓各州的竊聽法面臨新的法律考驗。
彭博報導，蘋果本周宣布推出的「Siri Recap」，可整理使用者全天對話內容並產生摘要，「Live Rewind」則能顯示使用者過去15秒所說內容的逐字轉錄，只要連按兩下Apple Watch錶冠即可啟動。
蘋果似乎意識到潛在問題，因此在公布這些功能時，強調多項隱私保護措施，包括使用者要求「Live Rewind」轉錄內容時會發出聲音提示、音訊在裝置端處理，以及強調原始音訊實際上並未被錄製或儲存。

連續處理語音是否構成「攔截」？

不過疑慮關鍵在於，即使裝置只是持續處理語音、沒有建立傳統的音訊檔案，這種行為是否仍可能按照各州法律，被視為「錄音」或「攔截」。
目前加州、麻薩諸塞州、賓州及華盛頓州的律師與法律專家，已經開始檢視這些隱私防護措施是否足以讓使用者免於潛在的法律問題。
波士頓刑事辯護律師Joe Simons認為，這些細節先前還沒有經過訴訟，並預測這種情況在麻州將成為「首宗判例」。賓州辯護律師Phil Lauer則表示，這項技術「非常接近合法，因為實際上並不是某個人接收並使用這些資料」，但「仍可以主張這是違法的」，因為裝置確實正在接收音訊並進行解讀。

AI裝置成為日常陪伴 竊聽疑慮升溫

科技巨頭投入大量資金製造及開發AI穿戴裝置之際，隱私疑慮也油然而生。這類產品被定位為使用者日常生活中的「常駐」工具，例如Meta Platforms(META-US)旗下熱門智慧眼鏡，就因可能遭到秘密錄音而引發反彈。
甚至還有專門設計用於錄音的AI裝置，例如Plaud與Pocket推出的產品。但關鍵差異在於，這些裝置只有在使用者按下按鈕後才會開始聆聽，而蘋果公司此次推出的功能，具備了持續聆聽的能力。
一名X用戶針對Live Rewind功能寫道：「監控現在變得更加普及。」
針對外界質疑，蘋果把「Siri Recap」與「Live Rewind」定位為幫助使用者喚回記憶的工具，而非用來建立詳細對話紀錄的功能。蘋果也表示，這些摘要會排除敏感資訊，例如財務細節、個人識別資訊及身分驗證資料。
然而，隨著涉及失控AI代理人的事件陸續發生，外界對AI安全防護機制的信任正在下降。在此背景下，Apple的新功能以及公司宣稱「沒有任何內容被錄製」的說法，也可能引發嚴重的安全疑慮。

專家：使用前最好先取得同意

Chandra Law Firm LLC創辦人暨管理合夥人Subodh Chandra表示，在使用這些AI新功能前，使用者最好先清楚了解相關法律，「我的建議是，把這項功能視為可能被法律認定為竊聽法規下的攔截，因此應該先取得同意」。
也有專家指出，使用者實際上可能沒有什麼方式可以同意或拒絕這項「錄音」功能。電子前線基金會(EFF)隱私訴訟主任Adam Schwartz說：「人們實際上沒有可行的方式來同意或拒絕錄音。我們建議人們在使用這項技術前三思，這是出於對他人對話隱私的尊重。」
蘋果則反駁這些功能並不屬於「錄製對話」，根據官方指引，使用者應「考量」身邊的人，尤其是在對話可能涉及隱私或敏感內容的情況下。
蘋果在聲明中表示，人們長期以來就有不同工具可以用來做筆記，包括手機與穿戴式裝置，因此新功能與這些工具並無不同。蘋果也表示，音訊是在安全硬體上處理，該硬體無法由作業系統、蘋果或其他任何人存取。
paras_en: Apple Inc. (AAPL-US) recently released the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, which include an AI capability that can “listen at any time.” While the feature promises greater convenience, it also raises data‑privacy concerns that could put state eavesdropping statutes to a new legal test.

Bloomberg reported that Apple announced this week a feature called “Siri Recap,” which compiles a day’s worth of user conversations into a summary, and a “Live Rewind” function that displays a verbatim transcript of what the user said in the past 15 seconds. Both are activated by double‑pressing the watch crown.

Apple appears aware of the potential issues, and when unveiling the features it highlighted several privacy safeguards, including an audible cue when a user requests a Live Rewind transcript, on‑device audio processing, and the claim that the raw audio is neither recorded nor stored.
Does continuous voice processing constitute “interception”?

The key concern is whether, even if the device only processes speech continuously without creating a traditional audio file, such activity might still be deemed a “recording” or “interception” under various state laws.

Boston criminal defense attorney Joe Simons says the details have not yet been litigated and predicts this could become the first precedent in Massachusetts. Pennsylvania defense lawyer Phil Lauer notes the technology is “very close to legal because no one is actually receiving and using the data,” yet “it can still be argued illegal” because the device does receive and interpret audio.

AI devices are becoming everyday companions, heightening eavesdropping worries. As tech giants pour money into AI wearables, privacy concerns naturally arise. These products are marketed as “resident” tools in users’ daily lives; for example, Meta Platforms’ (META-US) popular smart glasses have faced backlash over potential secret recordings.

There are even AI devices designed specifically for recording, such as those from Plaud and Pocket, which only start listening when the user presses a button. Apple’s new functions, by contrast, have continuous‑listening capability.
An X user wrote about the Live Rewind feature: “Surveillance is becoming more ubiquitous now.”

In response to criticism, Apple frames Siri Recap and Live Rewind as tools to help users recall memories rather than to create detailed conversation logs. The company also says the summaries will omit sensitive information such as financial details, personally identifying information, and authentication data.

However, as incidents involving out‑of‑control AI agents continue to surface, public trust in AI safety mechanisms is eroding. Against this backdrop, Apple’s new features and its claim that “no content is recorded” could raise serious security concerns.

Expert advice: obtain consent first. Subodh Chandra, founder and managing partner of Chandra Law Firm LLC, advises users to understand the relevant laws before using these AI features, saying, “My recommendation is to treat this feature as something that could be deemed interception under eavesdropping statutes, so you should obtain consent beforehand.”

Other experts note that users may have little practical way to consent to or reject this “recording” function. Adam Schwartz, privacy litigation director at the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), said, “People effectively have no viable way to consent to or reject recording. We recommend people think twice before using this technology, out of respect for others’ conversational privacy.”

Apple counters that these functions do not constitute “recording conversations.” According to official guidance, users should “consider” the people around them, especially when a conversation may involve private or sensitive content.

In its statement, Apple notes that people have long used various tools—phones and wearables included—to take notes, and that the new features are no different. Apple also says audio is processed on secure hardware that cannot be accessed by the operating system, Apple, or anyone else.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。
